project.name: concorde-development
project.description: Development environment for the standalone Concorde workflow, a specification-driven development framework for Codex and Claude that turns change requests into reviewed, validated candidates through explicit software contracts.

nodes.name: test_capability_modules.py
nodes.summary: Contract tests verifying that capability module classes, agent/uses declarations, request/response schemas, and the uses dependency graph exactly match the capability registry, plus in-process composition tests for resolving declared capability edges.

nodes.name: test_run_capability.py
nodes.summary: CLI launcher tests for the run-capability entry point, checking accepted/rejected skill and capability names, the LangGraph/Python runtime identity check, and that an accepted skill actually reaches the real dispatcher and review launcher.

nodes.name: test_structured_results.py
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the structured result envelope: canonical Finding ordering, status-to-exit-code mapping, and that ValidationResult matches the normative envelope schema.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Empty package marker making tests/concorde/distribution a Python package for the distribution test suite.

nodes.name: test_build.py
nodes.summary: Golden-output, determinism, incremental-check-lifecycle and freshness tests for the framework build pipeline, asserting exact agent/skill projection bytes, manifest key ordering, and that the build check fails and passes correctly as sources and prompts change.

nodes.name: test_check_docsite_types.py
nodes.summary: Verifies that the docsite type-check's preparation and dependency installation operate only on a temporary copy of the docsite package, never mutating the real source tree.

nodes.name: test_consumer_install_end_to_end.py
nodes.summary: End-to-end acceptance test that installs the framework into a fresh consumer project and checks generated projections, public-skill installation with receipt ownership, absence of legacy operation-tier roots, and the CLAUDE.md protocol block.

nodes.name: test_fresh_clone_bootstrap.py
nodes.summary: Acceptance test that a fresh git clone carries no build output, that a single build command bootstraps a fully working checkout, and that editing a prompt without rebuilding fails every invocation closed.

nodes.name: test_install_concorde.py
nodes.summary: Large native-installer contract suite covering preview/apply semantics, manifest authority, viewer lock integrity, managed-runtime rebuild and rollback, conflict detection for unowned or modified files, and safe-relative path handling.

nodes.name: test_manifests.py
nodes.summary: Verifies the single build manifest declares native identity, profile and install layout, that the runtime reads its version from that manifest, and that the reflection template and native source install materialize the expected inventory.

nodes.name: test_package_validation.py
nodes.summary: Comprehensive deterministic package-validation rule suite covering prompt reachability, capability module inventory/constants/uses-cycles, agent spec structure and harness references, contract schema staleness, build-output freshness, and Spec-alignment checks against the registry for capabilities, agents, types and error codes.

nodes.name: test_prompt_resolver.py
nodes.summary: Tests the prompt-include resolver's cycle/diamond detection, unsafe or missing include rejection, variable binding rules, audience boundaries between worker/ambient/shared prompts, Protocol-prompt inclusion restrictions, and full reachability reporting.

nodes.name: test_protocol_guidance.py
nodes.summary: Installer tests for the single shared Protocol guidance asset: single-copy loading across Claude/Codex integrations, upgrade-safe user edits, marker/symlink conflict detection, and rejection of stale project-protocol bindings.

nodes.name: test_agent_executor.py
nodes.summary: Extensive tests for the Agent process executor and binding preflight: injected/scrubbed process handoff for Codex and Claude, structured completion envelope validation across roles, timeout/cancellation outcomes, instructions and binding digest tampering checks, and fail-closed behavior on stale configuration.

nodes.name: CapabilityModuleContractTests
nodes.summary: Asserts capability module names, the external-name rule, the global/lifecycle-stage class partition, agents/uses declarations, request/response schema exports, module-import-cycle freedom and main-routed capability membership all match the capability registry exactly.

nodes.name: InProcessCompositionTests
nodes.summary: Verifies in-process resolution follows the declared uses graph exactly, rejects an undeclared child capability with a stable error code, resolves declared dev-loop/reflections-triage edges, and allows self-recursion without a declared edge.

nodes.name: RunCapabilityLauncherTests
nodes.summary: Covers the run-capability CLI's argument validation for skill and capability names, the runtime identity check output, and that an accepted skill both reaches the real dispatcher and previews scoped code-review authority.

nodes.name: StructuredResultTests
nodes.summary: Checks canonical Finding ordering inside the result envelope, status-to-exit-code mapping, and that ValidationResult conforms to the normative envelope fields.

nodes.name: BuildGoldenTests
nodes.summary: Byte-exact golden tests comparing built agent bodies and skill projections against recorded fixtures, plus manifest key ordering and docs-instruction projection checks.

nodes.name: BuildDeterminismTests
nodes.summary: Confirms building twice yields byte-identical output and that the 'all' integration output equals the union of the Claude and Codex builds.

nodes.name: BuildCheckLifecycleTests
nodes.summary: Exercises the incremental build-check lifecycle: failing before build and passing after, re-failing on a prompt edit or an independent Protocol edit, and reporting unexpected or modified owned files without ever writing outside owned directories.

nodes.name: BuildFreshnessTests
nodes.summary: Tests verify_fresh's fail-closed behavior with no manifest, immediate pass after build, failure after editing or removing a recorded source, and that load_agent (and its load_role_prompt alias) verify freshness while returning effects and binding.

nodes.name: DocsiteTypeCheckTests
nodes.summary: Confirms the docsite type-check step prepares and installs dependencies only inside a temporary copy, never touching the real docsite source.

nodes.name: ConsumerInstallEndToEndAcceptance
nodes.summary: Installs the framework into a temporary consumer project once per class and asserts the generated projections, skill receipts, absence of legacy roots, the CLAUDE.md protocol block, and that describe-policy/init-propose work without the consumer building.

nodes.name: FreshCloneBootstrapAcceptance
nodes.summary: Validates that a freshly cloned checkout carries no build output, that one build command bootstraps a fully working clone, and that skipping a rebuild after a prompt edit fails every invocation closed.

nodes.name: NativeInstallerTests
nodes.summary: Very large suite covering the native installer's preview/apply CLI, manifest authority, viewer lock integrity, idempotent empty-target apply, preservation of unowned defaults, managed-runtime rebuild/removal, rollback on dependency or smoke failure, viewer Node-version gating, conflict detection for modified or unowned files, and safe-relative path validation.

nodes.name: ManifestContractTests
nodes.summary: Confirms the single manifest declares native identity/profile/install layout, that the runtime version comes from that manifest, that its inventory equals the root capabilities and templates, and that native source install materializes the framework correctly.

nodes.name: PromptRuleTests
nodes.summary: Deterministic validation-rule tests for prompt trees: a clean tree has no findings, resolver errors and unreachable prompts are reported with rule IDs, and name-lint catches unknown Concorde tokens in prompts and agent Specs.

nodes.name: CapabilityModuleRuleTests
nodes.summary: Deterministic rule tests for capability module packages: inventory mismatches, missing or wrong-typed mandatory constants, invalid class values, unknown or cyclic uses declarations, non-Agent objects, missing or extra skills per class, and external-name mismatches are each reported.

nodes.name: AgentRuleTests
nodes.summary: Deterministic rule tests for the agents package: inventory mismatches, duplicate names, missing or misnamed Spec files, missing/wrong headings, unknown harness or capability references, context declared outside the harness, and widened effects or limits are each reported.

nodes.name: ContractRuleTests
nodes.summary: Deterministic rule tests for the generated schemas contract file: missing or stale schemas are reported, a current file has no findings, and duplicate exported type identities are reported.

nodes.name: BuildOutputRuleTests
nodes.summary: Deterministic rule tests for build-output freshness: missing manifest, stale source, drifted output, and unexpected files in owned directories are reported, while a fresh build and unrelated generated files produce no findings.

nodes.name: SpecAlignmentCapabilitiesRuleTests
nodes.summary: Deterministic rule tests asserting the registry's concorde-capabilities block matches the capability module package exactly, reporting missing registries, absent/duplicate blocks, malformed JSON, mismatched class, and missing or extra capability entries.

nodes.name: SpecAlignmentAgentsRuleTests
nodes.summary: Deterministic rule tests asserting the registry's concorde-agents block matches the agents package exactly, reporting absent/duplicate blocks, malformed JSON, mismatched harness, and missing or extra agent entries.

nodes.name: SpecAlignmentTypesRuleTests
nodes.summary: Deterministic rule tests asserting the registry agrees with the generated type-boundary document: missing document, unknown type tokens, wrong version, and missing exported identities are reported.

nodes.name: SpecAlignmentErrorsRuleTests
nodes.summary: Deterministic rule tests for documented error codes: missing codes are reported as advisory findings, message text is never mistaken for a code, and documented codes or an absent boundary document produce no findings.

nodes.name: PromptResolverRuleTests
nodes.summary: Very large suite for the prompt-include resolver covering cycle and diamond-inclusion detection, missing/unsafe includes, unbound variables, malformed directives, audience boundary enforcement between worker/ambient/shared prompts, Protocol prompt inclusion rules, and end-to-end reachability reporting.

nodes.name: ProtocolGuidanceTests
nodes.summary: Installer tests for shared Protocol guidance covering single-asset loading across integrations, upgrade-safe survival of user edits, conflict detection on markers/symlinks/modified blocks, correct entry/fence ordering, stale-preview rejection, rollback on failure, and rejection of an outdated project protocol binding.

nodes.name: AgentExecutorTests
nodes.summary: Tests the Agent process executor's runtime bootstrap, injected and scrubbed Codex/Claude process handoff, per-role success/failure envelope contracts, generation-schema shaping, completion validation against limitations and gates, and fail-closed handling of zero-exit semantics, stale completions and unenforced configuration.

nodes.name: AgentBindingPreflightTests
nodes.summary: Preflight tests for agent bindings: tampered instructions or binding digests are refused, wrong context/result types and unknown agents are refused, writes beyond a no-write agent are refused, and runner timeout, keyboard-interrupt and successful runs each carry the correct binding digest and outcome.

nodes.name: _agents_package
nodes.summary: Test fixture builder that writes a minimal agents/ package with an __init__, module and Spec source into a temporary root for AgentRuleTests.

nodes.name: _registry
nodes.summary: Test fixture builder that writes a project registry document containing the given concorde-* JSON blocks for Spec-alignment rule tests.

nodes.name: test_change_worktree.py
nodes.summary: Tests that creating a Concorde change worktree for a self-hosted project triggers a build of the new worktree, while worktree creation for an unrelated project or one without a package root does not attempt a build.

nodes.name: test_check_executor.py
nodes.summary: Sandbox-execution tests for the check executor's real bubblewrap/namespace isolation: mutation attempts fail at the syscall, descendants and remounts cannot regain write access, private temporary writes succeed and are cleaned, timeouts kill detached descendants, and missing backends or unsupported OSes never launch the command.

nodes.name: test_permissions.py
nodes.summary: Verifies that normalized permission policy is frozen, canonical and deny-by-default; that a binding can only narrow leaf effects; that Codex and Claude launches render equivalent effective boundaries; and that structured launches require, canonically serialize, and digest-bind an agent binding.

nodes.name: test_worktree_boundary.py
nodes.summary: Tests that the worktree mutation boundary requires an explicit override for the primary worktree, uses only the committed base for a linked worktree, and reports no mutation boundary for a non-git directory.

nodes.name: test_reflection_parser.py
nodes.summary: Parses example reflection collections and checks the parser's vocabulary, bucket-derivation rules, canonical index ordering, feature/status selection, controlled rewrite behavior, and shape/vocabulary/duplicate-breach reporting against the reflection contract.

nodes.name: test_reflections_queue.py
nodes.summary: Very large suite for the reflections-triage queue CLI: read-only status/next-entry/plans reporting, config-driven ordering and skip/feature mapping, atomic plan updates and ID allocation, safe removal of merged/closed documents with rollback on partial failure, orphan-plan reporting, relocation between triage buckets, and per-entry validation findings.

nodes.name: test_typed_data.py
nodes.summary: Unit tests for typed Spec data: artifact references detect staleness/missing files/symlinks, canonical JSON rejects duplicate fields and non-finite numbers, and configuration migration preserves fields while rejecting a stale proposal.

nodes.name: build_fixture.py
nodes.summary: Shared test fixture that copies prompts, protocol, skills and agents into a temporary root and runs a real build there, so tests needing a working built package don't depend on the checkout already being built.

nodes.name: capability_json.py
nodes.summary: Test doubles for typed capability integration tests: builds capability invocation envelopes and project configuration, and provides a ScriptedAgent that substitutes only the external model process while the real graph, launch policy, completion decoding and receipt checks still run.

nodes.name: managed_runtime.py
nodes.summary: Test fixture that fabricates a minimal local LangGraph wheel/index and the installer environment variables needed to exercise Concorde's managed-runtime install path without a real network dependency.

nodes.name: paths.py
nodes.summary: Shared path constants (repository root, runtime source root, fixtures root) used across the test suite to locate real project files.

nodes.name: reflection_triage.py
nodes.summary: Shared fixtures for the installed reflection-triage workflow: writes reflection collections and plan documents, derives triage buckets, hashes project trees, and initializes temporary git-backed triage projects for the reflections-queue and reflection-parser tests.

nodes.name: test_docsite_scaffold.py
nodes.summary: Tests the docsite scaffold proposal/apply flow: deterministic proposals, GitHub-origin and GitHub Pages identity derivation, explicit override precedence, conflict detection on modified targets or stale saved proposals, and CLI propose/apply round-trips.

nodes.name: test_docsite_template.py
nodes.summary: Tests the docsite template's file-inventory and digest rules against both a fake package and the real repository: exact template/adapter file sets, deterministic content-sensitive digests, symlink rejection anywhere in the tree, and package-root manifest verification.

nodes.name: CreateWorktreeBuildsTests
nodes.summary: Verifies that creating a Concorde worktree for the self-hosted project builds the new worktree, while an unrelated project or a project without a package root does not trigger a build.

nodes.name: CheckExecutorTests
nodes.summary: Runs the check executor against a real bubblewrap sandbox to prove mutation attempts fail at the system call, namespace or descriptor tricks cannot regain project write access, reads and private temporary writes succeed, exit codes and streams are preserved, and timeouts or setup failures never let the command run unsandboxed.

nodes.name: PermissionTests
nodes.summary: Confirms permission policy normalization is frozen/canonical/deny-by-default, that bindings can only narrow leaf effects, that Codex and Claude render equivalent effective boundaries with no shell, that native review grants only owned reads while protecting host files, and that unavailable native enforcement requires a verified outer boundary.

nodes.name: AgentBindingLaunchTests
nodes.summary: Verifies structured launches require an agent binding, narrative launches cannot carry one, binding fields are canonically serialized and enforced, the binding participates in the launch digest, and finalizing a launch specification preserves it.

nodes.name: WorktreeBoundaryTests
nodes.summary: Confirms the primary worktree requires an explicit override to be treated as mutable, a linked worktree resolves its boundary from only the committed base, and a non-git directory has no mutation boundary at all.

nodes.name: ReflectionParserTests
nodes.summary: Parses the reflection contract's own examples and checks vocabulary/path rules, bucket-derivation helpers, canonical non-nested indexing, feature/status/occurrence selection, pending-record shape, unsupported triage fields, duplicate-breach detection, controlled rewrites that preserve identity, and bucket-placement/triage agreement.

nodes.name: ReflectionsQueueTests
nodes.summary: Exhaustive suite for the reflections-triage queue: read-only status/plan reporting, shared-config-driven ordering, atomic plan set/allocate operations, safe merged/closed document removal with full rollback on partial failure, orphan reporting, high-water tracking, triage relocation and transition between buckets, and per-entry validation findings.

nodes.name: TypedDataTests
nodes.summary: Checks that artifact references detect staleness, missing files and symlinks; that canonical JSON rejects duplicate fields and non-finite numbers; and that configuration migration preserves fields while rejecting a stale proposal.

nodes.name: ScriptedAgent
nodes.summary: Process-executor test double that intercepts the external model process call, decodes the typed runtime input and configuration from the prompt, and returns a scripted structured-output completion while every other real graph/policy/receipt path still executes.

nodes.name: DocsiteScaffoldTests
nodes.summary: Covers the docsite scaffold's proposal determinism and file set, identity defaults from a bare or GitHub-derived origin (including GitHub Pages), explicit-override precedence, invalid-input rejection, conflict detection on pre-existing or modified targets, stale saved-proposal rejection, and CLI propose/apply round-trips.

nodes.name: DocsiteTemplateFakePackageTests
nodes.summary: Against a synthetic light package, checks the template's exact file inventory, scaffold-only exclusions, workflow-template bytes, content-sensitive digest determinism, rejection of symlinks anywhere in the tree, and package-root manifest verification.

nodes.name: DocsiteTemplateRealRepositoryTests
nodes.summary: Runs the same template inventory and digest checks against the real repository, confirming expected stable files are included, disposable/project-owned paths are excluded, and the digest is stable across repeated calls.

nodes.name: build_package_copy
nodes.summary: Copies prompts, protocol, skills and agents into a temporary root and runs a real build there, returning the BuildResult for tests that need a working built package as a prerequisite.

nodes.name: create_langgraph_index
nodes.summary: Creates a tiny local wheel and package index exercising Concorde's linear LangGraph contract, used to satisfy the managed-runtime dependency install without a real network.

nodes.name: runtime_install_environment
nodes.summary: Builds the pip/uv environment variables that point dependency installation at the fabricated local LangGraph index.

nodes.name: _create_viewer_tools
nodes.summary: Private helper that materializes a minimal viewer tools/npm package fixture used by managed-runtime installer tests.

nodes.name: _graph_source
nodes.summary: Private helper returning the source text of a minimal LangGraph graph module embedded in the fabricated local wheel.

nodes.name: reflection_bucket_for
nodes.summary: Mirrors the runtime triage-bucket rule, deriving pending/planned/needs-comments purely from an entry's Triage and Human Intervention fields.

nodes.name: write_reflection_collection
nodes.summary: Writes a per-file reflection collection document into the correct triage bucket directory for test fixtures.

nodes.name: reflection_entry
nodes.summary: Builds a single reflection entry dict with the given identifier, feature and status plus contract-required fields, for use in fixture collections.

nodes.name: sha256
nodes.summary: Computes the SHA-256 digest of a file's bytes for tree-hash fixtures.

nodes.name: tree_hashes
nodes.summary: Computes a mapping of relative path to sha256 digest for every file under a root, used to assert that unrelated files are untouched by an operation.

nodes.name: initialize_project
nodes.summary: Initializes the minimal Concorde project configuration and registry stub that reflection/plan fixtures are attributed to.

nodes.name: create_triage_project
nodes.summary: Composes project initialization, git initialization and a batch of reflection entries into a ready-to-use triage fixture project.

nodes.name: write_high_water
nodes.summary: Writes the reflections-queue high-water marker file recording the next allocation index.

nodes.name: write_config
nodes.summary: Writes the minimal project .concorde/config.json fixture consumed by reflection and capability tests.

nodes.name: write_plan
nodes.summary: Writes a reflections-queue plan document fixture with route, status, effort, verification and implementation-location fields for queue tests.

nodes.name: git
nodes.summary: Runs a git subprocess command against a fixture repository root and returns its captured result.

nodes.name: initialize_git
nodes.summary: Initializes a git repository, sets a fixture identity, and creates the initial commit for a triage fixture project.

nodes.name: commit_change
nodes.summary: Stages and commits all pending changes in a fixture repository under a given commit message.

nodes.name: grid.mjs
nodes.summary: Implements fixed-cell grid placement math for architecture diagrams: resolves a component's grid cell to pixel coordinates and validates that every gridded component fits within bounds without overlap. Not an auto-layout engine, only deterministic cell arithmetic.

nodes.name: gridLayout
nodes.summary: Returns the active grid layout config (merged with DEFAULT_GRID) when a component's diagram declares grid mode, or null for free placement.

nodes.name: resolveComponentPos
nodes.summary: Resolves a component's pixel position from an explicit pos, or by mapping its row/col grid cell to pixel coordinates using the grid's origin, cell size and gaps.

nodes.name: validateGridPlacement
nodes.summary: Validates that every component assigned a grid cell fits within the grid's column/row bounds and that no two components occupy the same cell, recording diagnostic problems for violations.

nodes.name: render-architecture.mjs
nodes.summary: CLI entry-point script that renders an architecture diagram JSON document into a standalone SVG/HTML artifact: validates the diagram, lays out boundaries/components/connections, routes connection paths around obstacles, and emits the final SVG markup.
nodes.languageNotes: A single large orthogonal-routing algorithm (routeVia/alignFacingPorts/sideAwareBridgeCandidates) drives most of the file's complexity; validateArchitecture alone spans nearly 280 lines of diagnostic checks.

nodes.name: boundaryRect
nodes.summary: Computes a boundary's bounding rectangle by unioning the rectangles of its member components, applying boundary padding.

nodes.name: autoViewBoxFor
nodes.summary: Derives an auto-fit SVG viewBox width from the widest set of candidate boundaries/components when no explicit viewBox is configured.

nodes.name: expandBoundaryForReadableTitle
nodes.summary: Expands a boundary's rectangle horizontally when its title text would otherwise overflow the boundary frame at the minimum readable font size.

nodes.name: measureBoundaryTitle
nodes.summary: Measures a boundary title's rendered width and placement and determines whether the boundary needs expanding for readability.

nodes.name: layoutBoundaryTitles
nodes.summary: Lays out every boundary's title label, resolving overlaps between sibling boundary titles and expanding boundaries as needed for readable text.

nodes.name: resolveBoundaryTitles
nodes.summary: Top-level pass that resolves final boundary title placement and sizing across the whole diagram before rendering.

nodes.name: validateArchitecture
nodes.summary: Runs the full architecture diagram validation pipeline: schema-level component/boundary/connection checks, grid placement, routing clearance, and crossing/corridor/border-run/route-rhythm diagnostics, producing the problem list that blocks rendering on error.

nodes.name: buildLayoutReport
nodes.summary: Assembles the dry-run layout report (component boxes, boundary boxes, routed connection paths) for the #9 inspect/dry-run feature.

nodes.name: routeClearsComponents
nodes.summary: Checks whether a candidate connection route's points stay clear of every component's rectangle, excluding the connection's own endpoints.

nodes.name: sideAwareBridgeCandidates
nodes.summary: Generates candidate orthogonal bridge routes between two connection endpoints that respect each endpoint's preferred exit side.

nodes.name: portHasCornerClearance
nodes.summary: Checks whether a port point on a rectangle's side has enough clearance from the rectangle's corner to route a clean bend.

nodes.name: alignFacingPorts
nodes.summary: Chooses aligned port positions on two facing sides of the from/to shapes so a connection can be routed with a single straight or minimally-bent segment.

nodes.name: routeVia
nodes.summary: Core connection-routing algorithm: picks the routing strategy (straight, aligned-port or bridged) between two components/boundaries and returns the final via-point list, avoiding obstacles.

nodes.name: pathFor
nodes.summary: Builds the final rounded SVG path string for a connection from its resolved route points.

nodes.name: renderComponent
nodes.summary: Renders a single component's SVG box, label, sublabel, tag and optional brand mark.

nodes.name: renderLegend
nodes.summary: Renders the diagram legend box and its entries as SVG once footprint and obstacles have been resolved.

nodes.name: renderSvg
nodes.summary: Top-level render function that assembles the complete architecture SVG document from boundaries, components, connections and the legend.

nodes.name: render-dataflow.mjs
nodes.summary: CLI entry-point script that renders a data-flow diagram JSON document into a standalone SVG/HTML artifact: validates stages/nodes/flows, routes flow paths around obstacles, and emits the final SVG markup.

nodes.name: stageFrame
nodes.summary: Computes a pipeline stage's frame rectangle from its column position and configured width/height.

nodes.name: measureNode
nodes.summary: Measures a dataflow node's rendered box size based on its label, sublabel and tag text.

nodes.name: validateDataflow
nodes.summary: Runs the full dataflow diagram validation pipeline: schema-level node/stage/flow checks, routing clearance, and crossing/corridor/border-run/route-rhythm diagnostics.

nodes.name: routeVia
nodes.summary: Resolves the via points for a data-flow connection between two nodes, routing around intervening obstacles.

nodes.name: pathFor
nodes.summary: Builds the final rounded SVG path string for a data-flow edge from its resolved route points.

nodes.name: renderNode
nodes.summary: Renders a single dataflow node's SVG box, label and optional brand mark.

nodes.name: renderFlowLabel
nodes.summary: Renders a data-flow edge's label text at its computed midpoint position.

nodes.name: renderLegend
nodes.summary: Renders the dataflow diagram's legend box and entries as SVG.

nodes.name: renderSvg
nodes.summary: Top-level render function that assembles the complete dataflow SVG document from stages, nodes, flows and the legend.

nodes.name: render-lifecycle.mjs
nodes.summary: CLI entry-point script that renders a lifecycle/state diagram JSON document into a standalone SVG/HTML artifact: validates states/transitions/lanes, routes transition paths, and emits the final SVG markup.

nodes.name: measureState
nodes.summary: Measures a lifecycle state node's rendered box size based on its label and sublabel text.

nodes.name: validateLifecycle
nodes.summary: Runs the full lifecycle/state diagram validation pipeline: schema-level state/transition checks, routing clearance, and crossing/corridor/border-run/route-rhythm diagnostics.

nodes.name: routeVia
nodes.summary: Resolves the via points for a state transition edge between two states, routing around intervening obstacles and respecting preferred sides.

nodes.name: pathFor
nodes.summary: Builds the final rounded SVG path string for a lifecycle transition from its resolved route points.

nodes.name: bandTitles
nodes.summary: Computes the title labels and positions for each lifecycle lane/band.

nodes.name: renderBands
nodes.summary: Renders the lifecycle diagram's lane/band background frames and titles as SVG.

nodes.name: renderState
nodes.summary: Renders a single lifecycle state node's SVG box, label, sublabel and optional brand mark.

nodes.name: renderTransitionLabel
nodes.summary: Renders a state transition edge's label text at its computed position.

nodes.name: renderLegend
nodes.summary: Renders the lifecycle diagram's legend box and entries as SVG.

nodes.name: renderSvg
nodes.summary: Top-level render function that assembles the complete lifecycle SVG document from bands, states, transitions and the legend.

nodes.name: render-sequence.mjs
nodes.summary: CLI entry-point script that renders a sequence diagram JSON document into a standalone SVG/HTML artifact: validates participants/messages/activations, lays out lifelines, and emits the final SVG markup.

nodes.name: messageLabelBox
nodes.summary: Computes the bounding box of a sequence message's label text for collision and legend-obstacle checks.

nodes.name: messageRouteBox
nodes.summary: Computes the bounding box of a sequence message's routed line for collision checks.

nodes.name: validateSequence
nodes.summary: Runs the full sequence diagram validation pipeline: schema-level participant/message/activation checks, routing clearance, and crossing/label-overlap diagnostics.

nodes.name: renderParticipant
nodes.summary: Renders a single sequence participant's header box, label and lifeline start.

nodes.name: renderSegmentLabel
nodes.summary: Renders a sequence segment (e.g. loop/alt) label at its computed position.

nodes.name: messageLabel
nodes.summary: Computes and positions a sequence message's label text between its two x-coordinates.

nodes.name: renderMessage
nodes.summary: Renders a single sequence message arrow or dashed line between two participants.

nodes.name: renderLegend
nodes.summary: Renders the sequence diagram's legend box and entries as SVG.

nodes.name: renderSvg
nodes.summary: Top-level render function that assembles the complete sequence diagram SVG document from participants, lifelines, activations and messages.

nodes.name: brand-marks.mjs
nodes.summary: Looks up, fetches, caches and renders brand/vendor icon marks (favicons/logos) for diagram nodes, including SSRF-safe remote fetching with private-address blocking, response-size limits and deadline enforcement.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements DNS-rebinding-safe fetches by resolving and validating the target address before pinning the HTTP request to it, rather than trusting the URL's hostname at request time.

nodes.name: findBrandMark
nodes.summary: Looks up a brand mark entry by id, alias or matching domain against the generated brand catalog.

nodes.name: listBrandMarks
nodes.summary: Returns the full list of known brand mark ids and titles from the generated catalog.

nodes.name: ipv4Private
nodes.summary: Checks whether an IPv4 address falls within a private, loopback or link-local range.

nodes.name: ipv6Private
nodes.summary: Checks whether an IPv6 address falls within a private, loopback, link-local or unique-local range.

nodes.name: isPrivateBrandAddress
nodes.summary: Determines whether a resolved brand-mark request address is private/internal, dispatching to the IPv4 or IPv6 range check.

nodes.name: validateUrlShape
nodes.summary: Validates that a candidate brand-mark URL string is well-formed http(s) before attempting to fetch it.

nodes.name: beforeDeadline
nodes.summary: Races a promise against a deadline timestamp, resolving or rejecting with whichever comes first.

nodes.name: resolveRequestTarget
nodes.summary: Resolves and validates the network target (host/address) a brand-mark fetch would connect to, rejecting private addresses.

nodes.name: requestPinned
nodes.summary: Performs an HTTP(S) request pinned to a pre-resolved, verified-public IP address to prevent DNS-rebinding SSRF, honoring a deadline.

nodes.name: checkedFetch
nodes.summary: Fetches a URL with SSRF-safe address resolution/pinning and Accept-header/deadline enforcement, wrapping errors as diagnostics.

nodes.name: readLimited
nodes.summary: Reads a fetch Response body up to a maximum byte limit, aborting the connection if the limit is exceeded.

nodes.name: iconCandidates
nodes.summary: Extracts candidate favicon/icon URLs from a page's parsed HTML link tags, ordered by preference.

nodes.name: imageData
nodes.summary: Fetches and validates a candidate icon image response, converting it into an embeddable data payload with content-type and size checks.

nodes.name: captureRemoteBrand
nodes.summary: Orchestrates fetching a remote brand mark: resolves the target site's HTML, extracts icon candidates, and fetches/validates the best available icon image with SSRF protections and a deadline.

nodes.name: captureBrandReference
nodes.summary: Captures a brand mark from a full external reference object (url + sha256), verifying the fetched content's hash matches before accepting it.

nodes.name: mapConcurrent
nodes.summary: Maps an async function over a list of values with a bounded concurrency limit.

nodes.name: prepareDiagramBrandMarks
nodes.summary: Resolves every brand reference used across a diagram's nodes into concrete brand mark data (catalog lookup, remote capture or reference capture) with bounded concurrency, ahead of rendering.

nodes.name: brandMarkFor

nodes.name: validateGuidedViews

nodes.name: svgRootAttrs

nodes.name: func3

nodes.name: geometry.mjs

nodes.name: asArray
nodes.summary: Normalizes a value into an array, wrapping non-array or undefined input.

nodes.name: isFinitePoint
nodes.summary: Checks that every coordinate argument is a finite number, guarding geometry helpers against NaN/Infinity input.

nodes.name: rectsOverlap
nodes.summary: Tests whether two axis-aligned rectangles overlap, with an optional padding margin.

nodes.name: segmentIntersectsRect
nodes.summary: Tests whether a line segment intersects an axis-aligned rectangle.

nodes.name: segmentRectClearance
nodes.summary: Computes the minimum clearance distance between a line segment and a rectangle's edges.

nodes.name: segmentRectIntersectionLength
nodes.summary: Computes how much of a line segment's length runs inside or too close to a rectangle, used to penalize routes that graze obstacles.

nodes.name: collectLabelRouteClearance
nodes.summary: Collects diagnostic-worthy clearance problems between connection/edge labels and routed lines across the whole diagram.

nodes.name: relationshipSubject
nodes.summary: Builds the diagnostic subject descriptor (kind, id, index) for a relationship/edge used in problem reporting.

nodes.name: endpointSideIssue
nodes.summary: Checks whether a route's points properly depart from an endpoint on its declared preferred side, returning a diagnostic issue if not.

nodes.name: routeHonorsEndpointSides
nodes.summary: Convenience wrapper returning whether a route path honors both endpoints' preferred sides.

nodes.name: cleanEndpointSideProblems
nodes.summary: Collects diagnostic problems for every routed connection whose endpoints don't depart on their declared preferred side.

nodes.name: cleanFlowProblems
nodes.summary: Collects diagnostic problems for routes that don't flow monotonically or double back on themselves unexpectedly.

nodes.name: cleanCrossingProblems
nodes.summary: Collects diagnostic problems for pairs of routed connections that cross each other unnecessarily.

nodes.name: collectAmbiguousCorridors
nodes.summary: Detects routing corridors shared by multiple connections that run too close together to visually distinguish, returning the ambiguous groups.

nodes.name: cleanAmbiguousCorridorProblems
nodes.summary: Converts ambiguous shared-corridor groups into diagnostic problems for the validation pipeline.

nodes.name: collectBorderRuns
nodes.summary: Detects sequences of routed segments that run flush along a shape's border for a suspiciously long distance.

nodes.name: cleanBorderRunProblems
nodes.summary: Converts detected long border-hugging route runs into diagnostic problems.

nodes.name: routeBudgetMetrics
nodes.summary: Computes aggregate routing-quality metrics (bend count, length, corridor usage) against configured budgets for the whole diagram.

nodes.name: collectRouteRhythmIssues
nodes.summary: Detects inconsistent bend 'rhythm' among a set of parallel or related routes that should look visually consistent.

nodes.name: cleanRouteRhythmProblems
nodes.summary: Converts detected route-rhythm inconsistencies into diagnostic problems.

nodes.name: cleanLabelRouteClearanceProblems
nodes.summary: Converts collected label/route clearance conflicts into diagnostic problems for the validation pipeline.

nodes.name: normalizeRoutePoints
nodes.summary: Deduplicates and cleans up a list of route via-points, dropping redundant collinear intermediate points.

nodes.name: frameBorderSegments
nodes.summary: Computes the four border line segments of a shape's frame rectangle.

nodes.name: mergeBorderOverlaps
nodes.summary: Merges overlapping border-run intervals detected along the same shape edge.

nodes.name: collinearAxisOverlap
nodes.summary: Checks whether two collinear segments on the same axis overlap and by how much.

nodes.name: properSegmentIntersection
nodes.summary: Tests whether two line segments properly intersect (crossing, not just touching at an endpoint).

nodes.name: segmentsIntersect
nodes.summary: Tests whether two general line segments intersect using orientation and on-segment checks.

nodes.name: anchor
nodes.summary: Computes the anchor point on a rectangle's given side (left/right/top/bottom) for connection routing.

nodes.name: automaticPortRhythmBridge
nodes.summary: Computes an automatic bridging route between two ports that keeps consistent bend rhythm with sibling connections.

nodes.name: automaticPortSpread
nodes.summary: Spreads multiple connections sharing the same port/side apart so their lines don't overlap at the shared anchor.

nodes.name: defaultFromSide
nodes.summary: Picks the default exit side on the 'from' shape for a connection based on the relative position of the 'to' shape.

nodes.name: defaultToSide
nodes.summary: Picks the default entry side on the 'to' shape for a connection based on the relative position of the 'from' shape.

nodes.name: chosenSide
nodes.summary: Returns an explicitly configured side if valid, otherwise falls back to the computed default side.

nodes.name: polylinePath
nodes.summary: Formats a list of points as a plain SVG polyline points path string.

nodes.name: routePointsValue
nodes.summary: Formats a route's points as the flat numeric list used by the route schema/points attribute.

nodes.name: roundedPath
nodes.summary: Builds an SVG path d string with rounded corners at each bend of a polyline route.

nodes.name: labelPoint
nodes.summary: Computes the placement point for a connection/edge label along its routed path, honoring explicit offsets.

nodes.name: variantAccent
nodes.summary: Maps a connection/edge variant name to its accent color/style class.

nodes.name: formatRect
nodes.summary: Formats a rectangle's coordinates as a rounded, human-readable string for diagnostic messages.

nodes.name: suggestLabelObstacleFix
nodes.summary: Builds a suggested fix description for a label overlapping an obstacle, used in diagnostic supportedFixes.

nodes.name: suggestLabelPairFix
nodes.summary: Builds a suggested fix description for two overlapping labels.

nodes.name: suggestComponentSeparation
nodes.summary: Builds a suggested fix description for two components positioned too close together.

nodes.name: i18n.mjs
nodes.summary: Defines the supported locale catalog and translation helpers (message interpolation, pluralized counts, HTML escaping) shared by every renderer to localize diagram text between English and Chinese.

nodes.name: escapeHtml
nodes.summary: Escapes HTML special characters in a value for safe embedding in generated SVG/HTML markup.

nodes.name: resolveLocale
nodes.summary: Resolves a requested locale string to a supported locale, defaulting to DEFAULT_LOCALE when unsupported.

nodes.name: formatMessage
nodes.summary: Interpolates {placeholder} tokens in a message template with provided values.

nodes.name: translateMessage
nodes.summary: Looks up and formats a translated message for a given locale and catalog key.

nodes.name: translateCount
nodes.summary: Looks up a pluralized translation variant for a count-dependent message key.

nodes.name: viewerCatalog
nodes.summary: Returns the flattened translation catalog for a locale, embedded as the runtime viewer's client-side strings.

nodes.name: localizeTemplate
nodes.summary: Applies locale-specific text substitutions to an HTML template before final assembly.

nodes.name: catalogKeys
nodes.summary: Lists every translation key defined in the catalog, used to verify locale completeness.

nodes.name: layout-report.mjs
nodes.summary: Serializes computed architecture layout (component boxes, boundary boxes, routed connection paths) into plain JSON for the dry-run / inspect tooling (#9).

nodes.name: componentBox
nodes.summary: Serializes a component's resolved position, size and label into a plain JSON box object for the layout report.

nodes.name: boundaryBox
nodes.summary: Serializes a boundary's resolved rectangle and label into a plain JSON box object for the layout report.

nodes.name: connectionPath
nodes.summary: Serializes a connection's routed path, points and label position into a plain JSON object for the layout report.

nodes.name: legend.mjs
nodes.summary: Computes and renders the diagram legend: resolves which relationship/kind entries should appear, measures the legend's footprint against relationship-line obstacles, searches for a non-overlapping placement, and draws the legend box in SVG.

nodes.name: relationshipLegendObstacles
nodes.summary: Computes the rectangles occupied by relationship/edge lines that the legend box must avoid overlapping.

nodes.name: resolveLegend
nodes.summary: Resolves which legend entries to show (auto/all/hidden mode) based on which relationship kinds are actually present in the diagram.

nodes.name: legendFootprint
nodes.summary: Computes the legend box's pixel footprint (width and height) from its resolved entries and font sizing.

nodes.name: measureLegend
nodes.summary: Measures and positions the legend box, searching candidate placements that avoid overlapping diagram content and relationship-line obstacles.

nodes.name: renderLegend
nodes.summary: Renders the resolved legend box and its entries as SVG markup.

nodes.name: repository-evidence.mjs
nodes.summary: Verifies that a diagram's claimed source-of-truth (repository URL, revision, source file) is real by shelling out to git and checking the referenced commit and file actually exist, producing diagnostic failures with suggested fixes when evidence is missing or inconsistent.

nodes.name: evidenceFailure
nodes.summary: Builds and throws a structured diagnostic error for a repository-evidence verification failure, given a code/message and supporting subject/evidence.

nodes.name: runGit
nodes.summary: Runs a git command synchronously in the given repo root and returns its stdout, or null on failure.

nodes.name: verifiedSourcePath
nodes.summary: Resolves and validates that a diagram's claimed source file path exists on disk relative to the repo root, without escaping it.

nodes.name: hasRepositoryEvidence
nodes.summary: Checks whether a diagram declares repository-evidence metadata (source/revision) at all.

nodes.name: verifyRepositoryEvidence
nodes.summary: Verifies a diagram's repository-evidence claims end to end: confirms the repo/revision exist via git, the claimed source file exists at that revision, and the diagram's stated line counts/hrefs match, producing diagnostics on any mismatch.

nodes.name: text-fit.mjs
nodes.summary: Single-line SVG node text-fitting helpers shared by every renderer: shrinks a label's font size toward a legible minimum and computes minimum/available text widths so long labels shrink instead of overlapping their neighbors.

nodes.name: fittedNodeFontSize
nodes.summary: Shrinks a node text's font size toward a legible minimum so it fits within the available width without wrapping.

nodes.name: minimumNodeTextWidth
nodes.summary: Computes the minimum width a node's text needs at the minimum legible font size.

nodes.name: availableNodeTextWidth
nodes.summary: Computes the width available for a node's text given the node's overall width and padding.

nodes.name: utils.mjs
nodes.summary: Grab-bag of shared rendering utilities: HTML-escaping/localization re-exports, shared SVG `<defs>` markers/gradients, semantic sigils, supplementary card rendering, safe JSON-in-script serialization, and Mustache-like template substitution used to assemble the final HTML artifact.

nodes.name: renderDefinitions
nodes.summary: Renders the shared SVG defs block (arrow markers, gradients) reused across every diagram type.

nodes.name: renderSemanticSigil
nodes.summary: Renders the small semantic 'sigil' icon glyph used to distinguish node kinds.

nodes.name: renderCards
nodes.summary: Renders the optional supplementary 'cards' panel (extra callout content) attached to a diagram.

nodes.name: applyTemplate
nodes.summary: Applies the diagram's data into the base HTML template, substituting the SVG body, embedded JSON payload, locale catalog and viewer script placeholders to produce the final standalone artifact.

nodes.name: textUnits
nodes.summary: Splits label text into measurable rendering units (characters/graphemes) for width estimation.

nodes.name: validator.mjs
nodes.summary: Validates a diagram document against its generated JSON Schema via the AJV-generated validators, annotating each error's path with the nearest enclosing id/label for friendlier, LLM-fixable error messages.

nodes.name: annotatedPath
nodes.summary: Resolves a JSON Schema error's instance path to the nearest enclosing element's id/label, for friendlier error messages.

nodes.name: validateSchema
nodes.summary: Validates a diagram document against its diagram-type JSON Schema using the generated AJV validators, throwing an annotated diagnostic error listing every schema violation.

nodes.name: render-workflow.mjs
nodes.summary: CLI entry-point script that renders a workflow diagram JSON document into a standalone SVG/HTML artifact: validates lanes/phases/nodes/edges, routes edges across lanes, and emits the final SVG markup.

nodes.name: nodeContext
nodes.summary: Builds the context descriptor (lane, phase, group) for a workflow node used in layout and diagnostics.

nodes.name: measureNode
nodes.summary: Measures a workflow node's rendered box size based on its label, sublabel and tag text.

nodes.name: workflowCompositionFrames
nodes.summary: Computes the frame rectangles for workflow composition groups spanning multiple lanes/columns.

nodes.name: validateWorkflow
nodes.summary: Runs the full workflow diagram validation pipeline: schema-level lane/phase/node/edge checks, routing clearance, and crossing/corridor/border-run/route-rhythm diagnostics.

nodes.name: routeClearsUnrelatedNodes
nodes.summary: Checks whether a candidate edge route's points stay clear of every node not directly connected by that edge.

nodes.name: oneBendCrossLaneVia
nodes.summary: Computes a single-bend route for an edge crossing between two different lanes.

nodes.name: automaticOneBendSides
nodes.summary: Picks the automatic exit/entry sides for a one-bend cross-lane edge route.

nodes.name: routeVia
nodes.summary: Resolves the via points for a workflow edge between two nodes, choosing straight, same-lane or cross-lane bridging strategies.

nodes.name: workflowEdgeLabelPoint
nodes.summary: Computes the placement point for a workflow edge's label along its routed path.

nodes.name: edgeSides
nodes.summary: Resolves the effective from/to exit sides for a workflow edge, honoring explicit configuration or defaults.

nodes.name: pathFor
nodes.summary: Builds the final rounded SVG path string for a workflow edge from its resolved route points.

nodes.name: renderLane
nodes.summary: Renders a single workflow lane's background frame and label as SVG.

nodes.name: renderNode
nodes.summary: Renders a single workflow node's SVG box, label, sublabel, tag and optional brand mark.

nodes.name: renderEdgeLabel
nodes.summary: Renders a workflow edge's label text at its computed position.

nodes.name: renderLegend
nodes.summary: Renders the workflow diagram's legend box and entries as SVG.

nodes.name: renderSvg
nodes.summary: Top-level render function that assembles the complete workflow SVG document from lanes, phases, nodes, edges and the legend.

nodes.name: nodeBlock
nodes.summary: Test helper that extracts a specific node's SVG markup block from a rendered document by id, for targeted assertions.

nodes.name: geometry.test.mjs

nodes.summary: Test helper that locates the repository root for the MCO showcase example by walking up from the test file, used to resolve pinned example paths.

nodes.summary: Tests that the sequence diagram renderer widens participant columns and message labels to fit long text without overlap, covering wide participant boxes and labelled message columns.

nodes.summary: Test helper that renders a sequence diagram fixture to a temp file via the CLI and returns the parsed output document.

nodes.name: render

nodes.name: docusaurus.config.ts
nodes.summary: Docusaurus site configuration for the Concorde docsite: validates the project is Profile 11, loads docsite/site.json identity, and wires the scoped-content plugin, classic docs preset, Mermaid theme, local search and navbar/footer.
nodes.languageNotes: Config is computed at module load time (requireScoped, loadSiteIdentity run eagerly) rather than lazily, so a malformed site.json or wrong profile version fails the Docusaurus build immediately.

nodes.name: build-freshness.ts
nodes.summary: Verifies in TypeScript that generated/build-manifest.json and its recorded source file digests are current, so `npm run validate` fails closed the same way the Python host does when a prompt or capability changed since the last Concorde build.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Docusaurus plugin entry point (`concorde-content`) that loads the scoped Spec registry, exposes it as global plugin data, watches its source files, and on postBuild verifies every registered page was rendered and writes the build manifest, architecture graph and legacy redirect stubs.

nodes.name: materialize.ts
nodes.summary: Materializes the scoped Spec registry into Docusaurus-consumable Markdown files and a generated sidebar, staging each registered document, injecting identity anchors and rewriting links, plus rendering optional Agent instructions/Wire contracts projection pages.

nodes.name: model.ts
nodes.summary: Core Module publication model: loads and strictly validates the Concorde registry (targets, documents, dependencies, contracts) from disk into a ScopedRegistry, computes content digests, and provides anchor-injection and cross-document link rewriting used by the rest of the docsite pipeline.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses `asserts` (requireThat) as a lightweight validation/type-narrowing primitive and hand-rolled regex-based Markdown heading/fence scanning instead of a full Markdown parser, since only ATX headings and fenced JSON blocks need to be recognized.

nodes.name: projections.ts
nodes.summary: Loads and renders read-only "projection" pages (Agent instructions, Wire contracts) from the Concorde build's generated/docs/*.json outputs, explicitly labelled as rendered views rather than a second authoring source.

nodes.name: routes.ts
nodes.summary: Small route-normalization helpers (trailing-slash stripping, baseUrl-relative canonicalization) shared by the plugin's postBuild route check and the theme's current-page lookup.

nodes.name: site-identity.ts
nodes.summary: Parses and validates docsite/site.json against "site identity schema 1", the only project-specific configuration the adapter reads (title, URLs, org/project name, optional repository/tagline/homepage content).

nodes.name: build.ts
nodes.summary: Production build script: builds the site into a candidate directory via the Docusaurus CLI, validates the scoped build output, and atomically promotes the candidate to `build/` with rollback on failure.

nodes.name: prepare-publication.ts
nodes.summary: Shared publication-preparation step that stages the registered Spec Markdown via materializeScoped and clears the stale Docusaurus content cache before either preview (`start`) or production (`build`) runs.

nodes.name: start.ts
nodes.summary: Development preview entry point: prepares publication then launches the Docusaurus dev server via its CLI, forwarding CLI arguments.

nodes.name: validate.ts
nodes.summary: CLI validation entry point (`npm run validate`) that checks Concorde build freshness when applicable and loads/rewrites the scoped registry to catch broken links or malformed Specs before publishing.

nodes.name: ContentProvenance.tsx
nodes.summary: React component rendering a page's provenance metadata (kind, canonical source path, document ID, owning Module memberships, main visibility) as a collapsible aside.

nodes.name: verifyConcordeBuildFresh
nodes.summary: Reads generated/build-manifest.json, hashes each recorded source file with SHA-256, and throws a descriptive error naming the exact stale/missing file if any digest or the manifest itself does not match.

nodes.name: validateScopedBuild
nodes.summary: Post-build check that loads the current registry and cross-checks the emitted build-manifest.json and architecture-graph.json for staleness, then verifies every legacy alias route has a redirect stub referencing its canonical page.

nodes.name: scopedContent
nodes.summary: Default-exported Docusaurus plugin factory implementing loadContent, contentLoaded, getPathsToWatch and postBuild to publish the scoped Spec registry as the site's content and enforce route/manifest integrity at build time.

nodes.name: scopedSidebar
nodes.summary: Builds the nested Docusaurus sidebar structure from the registry's Module tree, placing each shared document once as a doc entry and reusing plain links for subsequent occurrences, and appending the optional Projections group.

nodes.name: materializeScoped
nodes.summary: Clears and regenerates docsite/.generated content: writes every registered page as staged Markdown with anchors injected and links rewritten, optionally renders the projection pages, writes the sidebar JSON, and stamps a materialization identity file keyed to the registry's source digest.

nodes.name: hash
nodes.summary: Computes a `sha256:`-prefixed hex digest of a string or Buffer, used throughout the registry loader for content and source identity.

nodes.name: legacyAliasRoute
nodes.summary: Derives the deterministic legacy `/specs/<target-id>/<hash>` redirect route for a target/source-path pair, kept for backward compatibility after canonical source-path routes replaced it.

nodes.name: primaryDocument
nodes.summary: Returns a Module target's single `module.md` document path, asserting exactly one exists among its registered documents.

nodes.name: prose
nodes.summary: Strips fenced code-block lines from Markdown source so heading detection only scans prose text, tracking fence markers to avoid matching headings inside code samples.

nodes.name: requireOntologySubsections
nodes.summary: Validates that a Module's Ontology section contains exactly the Entities and Relationships subsections, in that order and nested directly beneath it.

nodes.name: injectAnchors

nodes.name: safeRead

nodes.name: requireScoped
nodes.summary: Asserts the target project declares Concorde profile_version 11 in .concorde/config.json before the docsite adapter will publish it, with a descriptive error otherwise.

nodes.name: documentContext
nodes.summary: Parses and validates a document's single concorde-document JSON block, checking field shape, ID format, and that its declared targets exactly match the registry's expected membership for that path.

nodes.name: loadScopedRegistry
nodes.summary: The central registry loader: reads .concorde/config.json and the Module registry, exhaustively validates target/document/dependency/contract structure, resolves composition and uses/requires edges, computes routes, aliases and content digests, and returns the complete ScopedRegistry consumed by the rest of the docsite.
nodes.languageNotes: A single ~120-line function intentionally performs all registry admission checks together so that structural and semantic validation happen in one pass before any page is generated.

nodes.name: rewriteLinks
nodes.summary: Rewrites relative Markdown links in a page's content to their target pages' canonical routes, leaving external/absolute/anchor links and fenced code untouched, and throwing on an unregistered local link.

nodes.name: hasDocsProjections
nodes.summary: Checks whether this project's Concorde build produced both generated/docs/instructions.json and generated/docs/wire.json, gating whether the projection pages are built at all.

nodes.name: loadInstructionsProjection
nodes.summary: Loads and JSON-parses generated/docs/instructions.json into the typed InstructionsProjection shape via safeRead.

nodes.name: loadWireProjection
nodes.summary: Loads and JSON-parses generated/docs/wire.json into the typed WireProjection shape via safeRead.

nodes.name: renderInstructionsPage
nodes.summary: Renders the "Agent instructions" projection Markdown page listing every Skill (with its capability and body) and every Agent (with its Spec, Harness and contributing prompts), each fenced as a code block.

nodes.name: renderWirePage
nodes.summary: Renders the "Wire contracts" projection Markdown page listing every exported type's literal JSON Schema, fenced per type ID in sorted order.

nodes.name: normalizeRoute

nodes.name: capability_host.py

nodes.name: resolve_child_capability
nodes.summary: Imports and validates the child capability module for a parent-to-child capability delegation, raising SpecError on missing or malformed modules.

nodes.name: invoke_capability
nodes.summary: Resolves and invokes a child capability module's run() entry point on behalf of a parent capability.

nodes.name: _worktree
nodes.summary: Resolves or creates the Git worktree for a mutation task, refreshing the worktree registry via workspace_identity/ensure_change/create_worktree/refresh_registry.

nodes.name: _check_revision
nodes.summary: Computes the digest of every input file (change inputs plus discovered implementation files) a deterministic check depends on, to detect staleness.

nodes.name: _check
nodes.summary: Executes one deterministic check via execute_check, persists its raw output digest and re-checks the revision afterward to guard against concurrent drift.

nodes.name: _inspect_topology_design
nodes.summary: Diffs a candidate topology proposal against the current registry to compute affected Modules, changed document references and file ownership, raising SpecError on structural inconsistencies.

nodes.name: _validate_topology_proposal
nodes.summary: Validates an authored topology-design proposal file against the typed schema and current repository digest before it can be applied.

nodes.name: _topology_author
nodes.summary: Launches the topology-author Agent in an isolated worktree with the resolved topology-author context, compiles its policy, executes it and validates the returned proposal/gaps.

nodes.name: _main_topology_response
nodes.summary: Builds the typed response payload for a Main topology-design action, embedding proposal, outcome, application, files and gaps.

nodes.name: _prepare_topology
nodes.summary: Runs one or more topology-author invocations across tasks, collects per-file topology proposals, validates the merged repository state and reports readiness for application.

nodes.name: _apply_topology
nodes.summary: Atomically applies a validated topology proposal's file changes to the repository, checking source digests and preserving prior bytes if application fails.

nodes.name: _project_capability
nodes.summary: Resolves the target Module for a capability invocation from task/config input, selecting it from the Spec repository.

nodes.name: _dispatch
nodes.summary: Maps an incoming public capability name and task to the appropriate Main/Invocation method, forming the central capability routing table.

nodes.name: run_capability
nodes.summary: Public entry point that verifies build freshness, constructs a CapabilityHost/MainInvocation/Invocation, dispatches the named capability and returns its typed response with recorded evidence.

nodes.name: validate_invocation
nodes.summary: Validates a raw runtime_input payload against the invocation contract schema before a capability is dispatched.

nodes.name: invocation_failure
nodes.summary: Builds a typed failure response for a capability invocation, used by callers such as the Studio adapter to report errors uniformly.

nodes.name: json_main
nodes.summary: CLI entry point that reads a JSON invocation from stdin/argv, runs the capability and writes the typed JSON response.

nodes.name: CapabilityHost
nodes.summary: Frozen, per-invocation execution context (project/package roots, executor, sandbox and coordination flags, invocation id, evidence log) that every capability stage consumes and that owns agent invocation and observation.

nodes.name: MainInvocation
nodes.summary: Drives concorde-main's routing/discovery/answer/topology-design lifecycle: resolves candidate Module routes, stages the coordinator agent, validates its structured answer and runs topology-design proposals.

nodes.name: Invocation
nodes.summary: Drives one Module-bound change lifecycle end to end -- author, spec-review gate, plan, tasks, implement, validate, mark-ready and delivery -- staging agents and deterministic checks for each phase.

nodes.name: capability_service.py
nodes.summary: Public host API barrel that re-exports CapabilityHost and run_capability from capability_host.py as the Profile 11 scoped capability entry point.

nodes.name: configuration.py
nodes.summary: Explicit project capability configuration: loads, proposes and applies digest-bound changes to .concorde/config.json, guarding against concurrent modification via source-digest checks.

nodes.name: load_configuration
nodes.summary: Reads and validates the current .concorde/config.json capability configuration document against its typed schema.

nodes.name: propose_configuration
nodes.summary: Produces a ToolResult proposing a new capability configuration document together with the source digest it must be applied against.

nodes.name: apply_configuration
nodes.summary: Validates a proposed configuration against the current on-disk digest and atomically writes it via a temp-file rename, failing closed on any mismatch.

nodes.name: review.py
nodes.summary: Independent, target-bound Spec/code review lifecycle: only this host reads Git objects, builds immutable review capsules, runs the reviewer Agent with zero project write authority and persists review receipts and outstanding requirement state.

nodes.name: _changes
nodes.summary: Computes the Git diff for a review's scope (implementation files or full change) against a baseline commit, using git ls-tree/cat-file and difflib.

nodes.name: inputs
nodes.summary: Assembles the immutable review input snapshot (target revision, implementation digest, computed changes, prompt) for a review run.

nodes.name: _persist
nodes.summary: Writes the review's public and private artifacts to disk and updates the change state with the review outcome and requirement bookkeeping.

nodes.name: _validate
nodes.summary: Validates a reviewer Agent's returned findings/gaps payload against the review response contract, checking scope, required fields and file ownership.

nodes.name: review
nodes.summary: Runs one code or Spec review invocation end to end: builds the capsule, compiles the reviewer's policy, launches the Agent, validates the result and persists the receipt.

nodes.name: review_scope
nodes.summary: Fans a change-wide review request out into per-covering-Module review invocations and aggregates their outputs into a single response.

nodes.name: current
nodes.summary: Reports the current recorded review status for a target/mode, verifying its persisted artifact still matches the live inputs.

nodes.name: verify_required
nodes.summary: Re-verifies every review a change's state marks as required, invalidating stale entries whose recorded inputs no longer match current Spec/implementation state.

nodes.name: build.py
nodes.summary: Deterministic, network-free renderer that projects Agent and skill sources from agents/, prompts/ and skills/ into generated/ (and .claude/.agents skill trees), producing the byte-identical build manifest that run_capability and load_agent verify before trusting any instruction source.

nodes.name: _skill_metadata
nodes.summary: Reads and parses one skill's SKILL.md front matter into its declared name, description, integration scope and capability binding.

nodes.name: _skill_frontmatter
nodes.summary: Renders the YAML front-matter block for a projected SKILL.md output file.

nodes.name: render_skill
nodes.summary: Renders one skill's resolved prompt body plus front matter into its distributed SKILL.md output(s) for each configured integration.

nodes.name: render_langgraph
nodes.summary: Renders the generated LangGraph control-flow module output from its source.

nodes.name: render_protocol_schemas
nodes.summary: Renders the generated JSON schema outputs for the Spec Protocol's structured declaration blocks.

nodes.name: render_docs_instructions
nodes.summary: Renders the generated per-integration instruction documents consumed by Codex/Claude from their prompt sources.

nodes.name: render_docs_wire
nodes.summary: Renders the generated wire-format documentation output describing the typed contract shapes.

nodes.name: _manifest
nodes.summary: Builds the deterministic build manifest recording every rendered output's path, content digest and source files.

nodes.name: build
nodes.summary: Pure function that renders every Agent, skill, LangGraph, protocol and docs output in memory and returns the complete BuildResult without touching disk.

nodes.name: write_build
nodes.summary: Runs build() and writes every rendered output plus the manifest to disk, used by the CLI/dev-loop build step.

nodes.name: _owned_generated_tree
nodes.summary: Lists every file under generated/ that the build owns, used to detect stray or stale generated files.

nodes.name: check_build
nodes.summary: Verifies the on-disk generated/ tree exactly matches a fresh in-memory build, reporting any drift, missing or stray files.

nodes.name: recompute_protocol_manifest
nodes.summary: Recomputes and returns the accepted Protocol manifest digest from the current principles/templates sources.

nodes.name: verify_fresh
nodes.summary: Fails closed with BuildError(code='stale_build') unless the on-disk generated/ tree matches the current sources; called by run_capability and load_agent before trusting rendered instructions.

nodes.name: load_agent
nodes.summary: Loads one Agent's rendered instructions and build manifest entry after verifying build freshness, the sole path capability execution uses to read Agent instructions.

nodes.name: BuildError
nodes.summary: Exception raised for build/staleness failures, e.g. BuildError(code='stale_build') when generated/ no longer matches its sources.

nodes.name: package_validation.py
nodes.summary: Single deterministic validator over the current agents/, capabilities/ and skills/ inventories and their registered Spec declarations, emitting stable CONCORDE-* rule-id findings for every structural or alignment defect.

nodes.name: _validate_prompts
nodes.summary: Validates every prompt source under prompts/agents//skills against @include reachability, audience scoping and front-matter shape.

nodes.name: _load_capabilities_package
nodes.summary: Imports the capabilities package and reports a finding if it fails to import cleanly.

nodes.name: _capability_modules
nodes.summary: Enumerates every Python module registered under the capabilities package.

nodes.name: _skill_capabilities
nodes.summary: Cross-references every skill's declared capability binding against the actual capability module inventory.

nodes.name: _validate_capability_modules
nodes.summary: Validates each capability module's shape (run() signature, imports, side-effect discipline) against the deterministic/model-backed capability contract.

nodes.name: _load_agents_package
nodes.summary: Imports the top-level agents package and reports a finding if it fails to import cleanly.

nodes.name: _agent_modules
nodes.summary: Enumerates every Python module registered under the agents package.

nodes.name: _validate_agent_harness
nodes.summary: Validates one Agent module's declared Harness binding, spec path and constraints against the Agent model contract.

nodes.name: _validate_agents
nodes.summary: Runs _validate_agent_harness across every discovered Agent module and aggregates their findings.

nodes.name: _validate_contracts
nodes.summary: Validates registered structured concorde-contract declarations for internal consistency (id/version/schema agreement).

nodes.name: _registered_documents
nodes.summary: Collects every registered Spec Markdown document and its concorde-document metadata block across the project.

nodes.name: _document_header_id
nodes.summary: Extracts the declared document id from a Spec document's concorde-document header block.

nodes.name: _capability_code_inventory
nodes.summary: Builds the inventory of capability identifiers implemented in code, for cross-checking against registered Spec entities.

nodes.name: _validate_spec_capabilities_block
nodes.summary: Validates that every Spec-registered capability entity has a matching implementation module and vice versa.

nodes.name: _agent_code_inventory
nodes.summary: Builds the inventory of Agent identifiers implemented in code, for cross-checking against registered Spec entities.

nodes.name: _validate_spec_agents_block
nodes.summary: Validates that every Spec-registered Agent entity has a matching implementation module and vice versa.

nodes.name: _validate_spec_types
nodes.summary: Validates that structured type/contract identifiers referenced in Specs match their code-level schema declarations.

nodes.name: _raised_error_codes
nodes.summary: Statically collects every error code string raised in the codebase, for cross-checking against documented error Specs.

nodes.name: _validate_spec_errors
nodes.summary: Validates that every raised error code is documented in a registered Spec and vice versa.

nodes.name: _validate_spec_alignment
nodes.summary: Runs the full suite of Spec-to-code alignment checks (capabilities, agents, types, errors) and aggregates their findings.

nodes.name: _validate_build_outputs
nodes.summary: Validates that the on-disk generated/ build outputs are fresh and free of drift via check_build.

nodes.name: validate_package
nodes.summary: Public entry point that runs every package validation check (prompts, capabilities, agents, contracts, Spec alignment, build outputs) and returns the aggregated findings.

nodes.name: prompt_resolver.py
nodes.summary: Deterministic, pure resolver for Concorde prompt sources: walks @include directives with per-inclusion {KEY} variable substitution, enforces audience/scope rules, and returns the fully substituted prompt body used to render Agent instructions and skills.

nodes.name: _safe_relative
nodes.summary: Validates and normalizes a project-relative prompt path, rejecting absolute paths and traversal components.

nodes.name: _parse_prompt_file
nodes.summary: Parses one prompt Markdown file's YAML front matter and body into its audience/name declarations and raw content.

nodes.name: _parse_directive
nodes.summary: Parses one @include directive line into its target path and key=value binding arguments.

nodes.name: _check_scope
nodes.summary: Validates that an @include target is reachable under the including prompt's declared scope, raising on out-of-scope includes.

nodes.name: _substitute
nodes.summary: Substitutes bound {KEY} variables into a prompt body's text.

nodes.name: _resolve_body
nodes.summary: Recursively resolves a prompt body's @include directives into fully substituted text, tracking the source chain and visited set to prevent cycles.

nodes.name: resolve_role_prompt

nodes.name: resolve_skill_source

nodes.name: resolve_agent_spec
nodes.summary: Public entry point that resolves an Agent's spec.md source into its fully substituted text and source list.

nodes.name: find_unreachable_prompts
nodes.summary: Scans the prompt tree for source files never reached via any declared root's @include chain, for validation reporting.

nodes.name: check_reachability
nodes.summary: Convenience wrapper that raises on any unreachable prompt found by find_unreachable_prompts.

nodes.name: PromptResolverError
nodes.summary: Exception raised for malformed prompt sources, scope violations or broken @include chains.

nodes.name: ResolvedPrompt
nodes.summary: Immutable result of prompt resolution: the fully substituted body text plus the ordered list of contributing source files.

nodes.name: agent_executor.py

nodes.name: _domain_type
nodes.summary: Determines a launch specification's domain output type for completion-schema validation.

nodes.name: _is_native_executable
nodes.summary: Checks whether a resolved runtime path is a real, executable native Codex/Claude binary rather than a stub.

nodes.name: resolve_runtime_bootstrap
nodes.summary: Resolves and hashes every file composing the native runtime's bootstrap (executable plus supporting files) for a given integration.

nodes.name: verify_runtime_bootstrap
nodes.summary: Re-verifies a previously recorded runtime bootstrap file set still matches its recorded digests, failing closed on drift.

nodes.name: _completion_schema
nodes.summary: Builds the JSON schema the native agent's completion payload must validate against, keyed by capability/stage/domain type.

nodes.name: _default_runner
nodes.summary: Default subprocess runner that invokes the native CLI with the given argv/cwd/env/input and timeout.

nodes.name: _default_version_probe
nodes.summary: Default probe that queries the native integration's reported version string.

nodes.name: _codex_envelope
nodes.summary: Parses Codex's stdout transcript into its structured completion envelope.

nodes.name: _claude_envelope
nodes.summary: Parses Claude's stdout transcript into its structured completion envelope.

nodes.name: _validate_completion
nodes.summary: Validates a parsed completion envelope's status, gates and domain output against the expected completion schema, raising CapabilityExecutionError on violation.

nodes.name: _prompt
nodes.summary: Builds the final prompt text sent to the native agent process for one launch.

nodes.name: _role_prompt
nodes.summary: Resolves and assembles the complete role-specific instruction prompt (context, constraints, task, prior results) for a native agent launch.

nodes.name: _exact_effective_boundary
nodes.summary: Computes the exact effective read/write/network boundary a launch specification enforces, for the enforcement receipt.

nodes.name: CapabilityExecutionError

nodes.name: AgentProcessExecutor

nodes.name: agent_model.py

nodes.name: external_agent_name
nodes.summary: Maps an internal Agent identifier to its externally displayed agent name.

nodes.name: load_agent_inventory
nodes.summary: Loads the full inventory of declared Agent identifiers from the agents/ package.

nodes.name: load_agents
nodes.summary: Loads and constructs every declared Agent's Agent() record (name, spec, harness, constraints).

nodes.name: agent_definition
nodes.summary: Looks up one Agent's declared definition by name from the loaded inventory.

nodes.name: binding_json
nodes.summary: Serializes an AgentBinding to its canonical JSON representation.

nodes.name: binding_from_json
nodes.summary: Deserializes an AgentBinding from its canonical JSON representation.

nodes.name: resolve_agent
nodes.summary: Resolves a named Agent's current AgentBinding by verifying its spec/instructions digests against the build manifest and its declared Harness/Constraints, failing closed on any drift.

nodes.name: Constraints

nodes.name: Agent

nodes.name: AgentBinding

nodes.name: agent_runtime.py

nodes.name: InvalidAgentStep
