nodes.name: AgentStep
nodes.summary: One recorded step (source, action, agent id, value, outcome, details) in an Agent's decision trace.

nodes.name: AgentFrame
nodes.summary: Immutable invocation frame passed into one Agent decision: input, context, spec, feedback, remaining budget and deadline.

nodes.name: RuntimeAgent
nodes.summary: Runtime-bound wrapper around a declared Agent that supplies its decision function, delegation targets, input/result types and step budget.

nodes.name: AgentRuntime
nodes.summary: Top-level entry point that constructs the recursive call tree for one Agent invocation and returns its AgentRun (result plus full event trace).

nodes.name: _Tree
nodes.summary: Internal recursive call-tree engine that dispatches each Agent decision, enforces step/depth/timeout limits and executes delegated child invocations.

nodes.name: change_worktree.py

nodes.name: list_worktrees
nodes.summary: Lists every Git worktree linked to the primary repository, including ones created outside Concorde.

nodes.name: workspace_identity
nodes.summary: Resolves the current worktree's identity (root, branch, change id) used to scope host operations.

nodes.name: repository_lock
nodes.summary: Context manager that acquires an exclusive lock on the repository's control state for the duration of a mutation.

nodes.name: read_change

nodes.name: refresh_registry

nodes.name: strip_guidance

nodes.name: ensure_change
nodes.summary: Ensures a change record exists for the current task/worktree, creating one if this is the first mutation and enforcing the primary-worktree write restriction.

nodes.name: create_worktree
nodes.summary: Creates a new linked Git worktree for a candidate change and records it in the change state.

nodes.name: bind_owner
nodes.summary: Binds the owning task/coordination identity to a worktree's change state.

nodes.name: target_state
nodes.summary: Reads or initializes the per-target progress/graph state nested inside a change document.

nodes.name: progress
nodes.summary: Records a phase transition (status, outcome, gaps, invalidation) into a target's progress state.

nodes.name: graph_state
nodes.summary: Reads or updates a target's dependency-graph readiness state (policy, spec digest, implementation digest).

nodes.name: record_task_gaps
nodes.summary: Records the outstanding gaps reported by a phase for a task against its Spec digest, for later re-verification.

nodes.name: workspace_context
nodes.summary: Builds the workspace metadata (identity, worktree list, change inventory) supplied as task-context input to agent invocations.

nodes.name: snapshot_tree
nodes.summary: Builds a deterministic snapshot of the project tree's control-relevant state for a change, excluding generated/log files.

nodes.name: check_executor.py

nodes.name: _bubblewrap
nodes.summary: Locates and validates the bubblewrap binary used to construct the sandbox.

nodes.name: _read_info

nodes.name: execute_check

nodes.name: CheckResult
nodes.summary: Result of a sandboxed check execution: captured stdout, stderr, return code and timeout flag.

nodes.name: CheckSandboxError
nodes.summary: Exception raised when the sandbox itself cannot be constructed or fails unexpectedly.

nodes.name: CheckBackend
nodes.summary: Abstract interface a check execution backend implements (a single run() method).

nodes.name: BubblewrapBackend
nodes.summary: Linux bubblewrap-based CheckBackend implementation providing the read-only host mount, PID namespace isolation and pidfd-based process authority.

nodes.name: context.py

nodes.name: resolve_context
nodes.summary: Resolves the complete frozen context (Spec documents, implementation entries, task/constraints) for one phase of a target Module invocation.

nodes.name: resolve_discovery_context
nodes.summary: Resolves the frozen context for a Main routing/discovery invocation across candidate target Modules.

nodes.name: resolve_topology_author_context
nodes.summary: Resolves the frozen context for a topology-author invocation, including candidate document references.

nodes.name: recheck_context
nodes.summary: Re-verifies a previously resolved context snapshot still matches the live repository/workspace state.

nodes.name: recheck_discovery_context
nodes.summary: Re-verifies a previously resolved discovery context snapshot still matches the live repository state.

nodes.name: recheck_topology_author_context
nodes.summary: Re-verifies a previously resolved topology-author context snapshot still matches the live repository state.

nodes.name: assess_result
nodes.summary: Assesses an agent's returned result against its originating context snapshot for consistency.

nodes.name: ContextSnapshot
nodes.summary: Immutable frozen context snapshot for one phase invocation, with a stable serialized value and identity digest.

nodes.name: DiscoveryContext
nodes.summary: Immutable frozen context snapshot for a Main discovery/routing invocation.

nodes.name: TopologyAuthorContext
nodes.summary: Immutable frozen context snapshot for a topology-author invocation.

nodes.name: effects.py
nodes.summary: Shared, dependency-free effect-declaration vocabulary: EffectDeclaration names the exact path roles one launchable agent identity may read/write plus its network/credential posture, consumed by both roles.py and permissions.py.

nodes.name: EffectDeclaration
nodes.summary: Declares the closed set of read/write path roles plus network and credential posture one launchable agent identity is permitted, the single source both role authority and permission compilation draw from.

nodes.name: harness.py
nodes.summary: Owns Concorde's closed catalog of Harness definitions (organized execution environments: model integration, capabilities, tools, context assembly, control-loop policy, state and environment) and the harness() factory that builds and digests them.

nodes.name: harness
nodes.summary: Factory that constructs and digests a Harness record from its model integration, workspace, effects, contexts, results, loop policy, capabilities, tools and environment declarations.

nodes.name: LoopPolicy
nodes.summary: Control-loop policy for an Agent's execution: timeout and maximum turn count.

nodes.name: Harness
nodes.summary: Immutable, digested record of one Agent's complete execution environment: model, integrations, workspace, effects, capabilities, tools, contexts, results, loop and state.

nodes.name: native_agent.py
nodes.summary: Codex/Claude Agent adapter that makes one fresh native model decision per call and routes any child delegation back through the host, compiling the policy and building the launch specification for each invocation.

nodes.name: NativeAgentAdapter
nodes.summary: Adapter implementing the RuntimeAgent decide contract for real Codex/Claude native processes: compiles the effective policy, builds the launch specification and delegates execution to AgentProcessExecutor.

nodes.name: permissions.py
nodes.summary: Compiles an Agent's declared effects and AgentBinding into a normalized least-privilege policy, renders it into concrete Codex and Claude native configuration (permission profile/settings.json), and builds the tamper-evident LaunchSpecification and completion contract each native execution is checked against.

nodes.name: runtime_bootstrap_file
nodes.summary: Builds one RuntimeBootstrapFile record (path, digest, size, mode, owner) describing a native runtime file the launch depends on.

nodes.name: compile_policy
nodes.summary: Compiles an Agent's declared EffectDeclaration and AgentBinding into a NormalizedPolicy of concrete read/write/deny paths, network and credential posture.

nodes.name: verify_effective_subset
nodes.summary: Verifies a declared policy's effective boundary is a subset of what was actually granted, failing closed on any widening.

nodes.name: render_codex_configuration
nodes.summary: Renders a NormalizedPolicy into the concrete Codex native permission profile, approval policy and CLI argv.

nodes.name: finalize_codex_configuration
nodes.summary: Finalizes a rendered Codex configuration with its runtime bootstrap digest and enforcement receipt fields.

nodes.name: render_claude_configuration
nodes.summary: Renders a NormalizedPolicy into the concrete Claude native settings.json permission rules and CLI argv.

nodes.name: compare_effective_boundaries
nodes.summary: Compares two rendered native configurations' effective read/write/network boundaries for equivalence.

nodes.name: build_launch_specification
nodes.summary: Builds the complete tamper-evident LaunchSpecification for one Agent invocation, embedding the compiled policy, native configuration, prompt, prior results and workspace digest.

nodes.name: finalize_launch_specification
nodes.summary: Finalizes a LaunchSpecification with its runtime bootstrap digest before dispatch to the native executor.

nodes.name: PermissionPolicyError
nodes.summary: Exception raised for invalid or inconsistent permission policy compilation.

nodes.name: PolicyBinding
nodes.summary: Declares one invocation's requested capability/stage/occurrence/role/agent plus its requested read/write roles, network and credentials, the input compile_policy normalizes.

nodes.name: NormalizedPolicy
nodes.summary: Compiled least-privilege policy: concrete read/write/deny paths, default-deny posture, network/credential flags and a digest, the output of compile_policy.

nodes.name: CodexLaunchConfiguration
nodes.summary: Concrete rendered Codex native configuration: permission profile, approval policy, argv and effective boundary, ready to launch the Codex process.

nodes.name: ClaudeLaunchConfiguration
nodes.summary: Concrete rendered Claude native configuration: settings.json, permission mode, argv and effective boundary, ready to launch the Claude process.

nodes.name: LaunchSpecification
nodes.summary: Complete tamper-evident specification for one native Agent launch: capability/stage/role identity, project root, prompt, prior results, workspace digest and rendered native policy.

nodes.name: EnforcementReceipt
nodes.summary: Tamper-evident receipt recorded after a native launch: requested vs actual launch digest, policy/config digests, exit code, status and completion schema version.

nodes.name: CapabilityCompletion
nodes.summary: Structured completion payload a native agent reports back: schema version, status, output, limitations, gates and domain output.

nodes.name: roles.py
nodes.summary: Derived, read-only compatibility projection of the Agent inventory onto the former Role shape: ROLES is rebuilt from agent_model.load_agents() on every import so legacy importers keep working while new code migrates to agent_model directly.

nodes.name: Role
nodes.summary: Legacy-shaped role record (name, prompt, effects) derived one-to-one from the current Agent inventory for backward-compatible importers.

nodes.name: studio.py
nodes.summary: Optional LangGraph Studio adapter exposing the capability host as an inspectable graph; all execution still routes through run_capability so Studio never bypasses the public capability host's enforcement.

nodes.name: build_studio_graph
nodes.summary: Builds the LangGraph StateGraph wrapping one capability's run_capability invocation for inspection and streaming in LangGraph Studio.

nodes.name: studio_client.py
nodes.summary: Opt-in, standard-library-only CLI transport that sends one invocation to a locally running Studio server and streams back its result.

nodes.name: run_in_studio
nodes.summary: Public entry point that POSTs one invocation to a local Studio server URL, disabling redirects, and streams/returns its typed result.

nodes.name: worktree_delivery.py
nodes.summary: Implements the Concorde delivery capability that merges a validated candidate change from either the source change worktree or the primary worktree, producing a durable delivery receipt and optionally promoting it into the primary branch.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a durable JSON receipt written before any Git ref update so a restarted session can distinguish an unmerged candidate from pending cleanup (crash-safe two-phase commit pattern).

nodes.name: configuration.py
nodes.summary: Validates the shared reflection-triage configuration schema (ordering, approval requirement, skip list, directory paths) used by both project initialization and the reflections queue Tool.

nodes.name: investigation.py
nodes.summary: Validates a typed investigation result against its admitted contract and persists the triage sections and resolution plan for one or more reflections, using atomic write-with-verification to guard against concurrent modification.

nodes.name: reflections.py
nodes.summary: Parser and collection layer for per-file project reflection documents: resolves bucket/path conventions, parses Markdown reflection documents into structured entries, and aggregates them with duplicate/placement/vocabulary problem detection.
nodes.languageNotes: The bucket directory a document lives in is its only record of triage state; there is no separate triage/human_intervention front-matter field, so path and content must stay consistent.

nodes.name: scoped_triage.py
nodes.summary: Coordinates reflection triage and implementation from within a Module-scoped capability invocation: dispatches status/close/merge/record-gaps actions, stages a read-only investigation, and optionally routes verified fixes into concorde-dev-loop.

nodes.name: changes.py
nodes.summary: Digest-bound, rollback-safe application of document and configuration file changes owned by the host, including confirming previously pending entity files once they exist on disk.

nodes.name: contract_shapes.py
nodes.summary: Shared JSON Schema building blocks (task request/stage response shapes, gap/check/route/worktree fragments) reused by every capability's request/response contract, deliberately import-cycle-free.

nodes.name: require_delivery_session
nodes.summary: Admits only the change's registered source worktree or the primary worktree as the acting delivery session, preserving session provenance for later checks.

nodes.name: _verify_merged_tree
nodes.summary: Runs deterministic checks against a candidate merged commit/tree before it is promoted, recording check results for the delivery receipt.

nodes.name: _cleanup
nodes.summary: Removes or retains the source change worktree after a successful merge and finalizes the delivery receipt status.

nodes.name: deliver
nodes.summary: Public capability entry point: resolves the primary worktree, rebinds the host to it, and delegates to _deliver while recording failures for retry.

nodes.name: _remember_failure
nodes.summary: Persists a blocked or cleanup-pending delivery outcome onto the source change's state after a delivery attempt fails.

nodes.name: _deliver
nodes.summary: Core delivery state machine: verifies the candidate is ready, merges it into concorde/delivered/<change_id> via merge-tree, writes a durable receipt before any ref update, confirms pending files, and updates refs under the repository lock.

nodes.name: _merge_primary
nodes.summary: Promotes an already staged delivery receipt into the primary branch with an explicit merge_primary request, verifying the staged branch and primary branch have not drifted before a fast-forward merge.

nodes.name: _response
nodes.summary: Builds the typed concorde-deliver-response envelope describing merge outcome, confirmed/pending files, and primary-merge status.

nodes.name: validate_configuration
nodes.summary: Validates the reflection-triage configuration object's schema_version, order enum, require_approval flag, unique skip list, and required directory-path fields.

nodes.name: _replace_sections
nodes.summary: Replaces the content of named Markdown '## Heading' sections in a reflection document while tracking fenced code blocks so headings inside fences are not mistaken for section markers.

nodes.name: _plan_text
nodes.summary: Renders a resolution plan document's front matter and body from a verified investigation finding and its task.

nodes.name: _write_plan
nodes.summary: Writes a plan file atomically via a temp file plus rename, re-verifying the original bytes were unchanged both before and after the write to guard against concurrent modification.

nodes.name: apply_investigation
nodes.summary: Validates a typed investigation result against its admitted contract, applies the developer/human-intervention and staleness checks, updates the reflection document's triage sections, and persists the resolution plan and any downstream implementation gating.

nodes.name: bucket_for_intervention
nodes.summary: Maps a human_intervention decision to its owning bucket directory name (planned or needs-comments).

nodes.name: triage_state
nodes.summary: Derives the historical triage state string (pending/complete) from a document's current bucket.

nodes.name: human_intervention_for
nodes.summary: Derives the historical human_intervention value (required/not-required) from a document's current bucket.

nodes.name: split_reflection_path
nodes.summary: Splits a reflection document path into its (bucket, identifier) pair, or returns None for a flat legacy path outside every tracked bucket.

nodes.name: _sections
nodes.summary: Extracts the ordered '## Heading' sections and their body ranges from a reflection document's Markdown body, tracking fenced code blocks.

nodes.name: parse_reflection_document
nodes.summary: Parses one reflection Markdown document (front matter plus required sections) into a ReflectionEntry, collecting shape, vocabulary and duplicate-field ReflectionProblems instead of raising on malformed input.

nodes.name: _parse_index
nodes.summary: Parses the reflections index.json content into its schema-checked high-water mark value.

nodes.name: parse_reflections
nodes.summary: Parses every reflection document plus the index file into a ParsedReflections collection, aggregating per-document ReflectionProblems and detecting duplicate identifiers and stale high-water marks.

nodes.name: ReflectionEntry
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass representing one parsed reflection document, exposing derived properties (feature, status, bucket, triage, human_intervention, expected_path, misplaced) computed from its front-matter fields and current path.

nodes.name: ParsedReflections
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass aggregating all parsed reflection entries and problems, with query methods for per-attribution summaries, bucket counts, misplaced entries and closed entries.

nodes.name: triage
nodes.summary: Dispatches a reflection-triage capability task: routes status/close/merge/record-gaps actions, or stages a read-only investigation invocation and optionally routes a verified resolution into a fresh concorde-dev-loop invocation.

nodes.name: record_gaps
nodes.summary: Promotes selected open gaps from the change's gap history into new or existing Reflection documents, preserving their original ownership and attribution.

nodes.name: gap_records
nodes.summary: Returns public gap-history metadata scoped to the caller's Module, its dependencies and its children, without reading any source files.

nodes.name: file_change
nodes.summary: Builds one proposed file-change record (path, before-digest, new content) used across proposal and apply flows.

nodes.name: apply_files
nodes.summary: Applies a set of file changes atomically under a digest-checked, allowed-path guard, backing up and restoring originals on any failure or post-write verification error.

nodes.name: _rewrite_entities
nodes.summary: Rewrites a Module document's concorde-entities JSON block, clearing pending markers for confirmed files.

nodes.name: confirm_pending_files
nodes.summary: Scans every target's declared pending entity files, confirms which now exist on disk, and rewrites their entity declarations to clear the pending marker as part of delivery.

nodes.name: task_request
nodes.summary: Builds the task-selection request schema shared by every capability, making target_id required for stage capabilities or optional for global capabilities that still route.

nodes.name: stage_response
nodes.summary: Builds the stage/lifecycle response schema shared by every capability (outcome enum, answer, artifacts, gaps, checks, completed_capabilities).

nodes.name: queue_module
nodes.summary: Dynamically loads the host-private legacy reflections_queue.py script as a module, the compatibility bridge between the typed capability layer and the pre-existing queue implementation.

nodes.name: contracts.py
nodes.summary: Profile 11 capability registry: declares versioned JSON contracts for every global and lifecycle capability plus the internal (non-capability) data types such as topology design and review internals, and lazily collects per-capability schemas.

nodes.name: frontmatter.py
nodes.summary: Constrained YAML-front-matter parser shared by Concorde's Markdown readers, supporting a deliberately restricted scalar/list/mapping subset with strict duplicate-key and indentation checks.

nodes.name: initialize.py
nodes.summary: Builds and applies the initial four-part Module profile stub for a freshly initialized project: proposes the config/registry/module.md file set, binds the pinned Protocol digest, and validates the result before applying it.

nodes.name: model.py
nodes.summary: Immutable result entities (Finding, ProposalFile, ToolResult) shared by Concorde Tools as their common return-value vocabulary for findings, proposed file changes and Tool outcomes.

nodes.name: repository.py
nodes.summary: Core Spec repository model implementing Profile 11: loads the project registry, parses Module documents into targets/entities/requirements/scenarios, and resolves entity file listings, dependencies and implementation contexts without reading a collaborator's body.
nodes.languageNotes: Deliberately separates Module composition, dependency and file-listing as independent relations; resolving a Module never reads a collaborator's contents.

nodes.name: schema.py
nodes.summary: Offline JSON Schema subset admitted and validated by published Concorde contracts, an intentionally advertised subset (local $ref only, restricted keyword set) rather than full JSON Schema support.

nodes.name: typed_data.py
nodes.summary: Versioned TypedValue envelope validation shared at every capability and leaf data boundary: canonical JSON encoding, schema checking, safe project-relative path handling and artifact digest verification.
nodes.languageNotes: Validation is hand-rolled against the standard library only, so admission works before the managed LangGraph runtime is installed.

nodes.name: dependencies
nodes.summary: Returns the CHECK/ROUTE-shaped dependency declarations for one capability's registered request/response contract pairing.

nodes.name: load_capability_inventory
nodes.summary: Loads and returns the full registered capability inventory (identities paired with their context/result type IDs) used to populate CAPABILITY_CONTRACTS.

nodes.name: _capability_schemas
nodes.summary: Builds the per-capability request/response JSON schema mapping by importing each capability module lazily to avoid a module-load-time cycle.

nodes.name: schemas
nodes.summary: Collects and returns every versioned data type schema owned directly by this module (topology proposals, discovery context, review internals, worktree/gap/route shapes) merged with the lazily-collected per-capability schemas.

nodes.name: _scalar
nodes.summary: Parses one restricted YAML scalar token (string, integer, boolean, null, or quoted string) with strict error reporting by source line.

nodes.name: _meaningful
nodes.summary: Determines whether a block of raw lines carries meaningful (non-comment, non-blank) content for the constrained parser.

nodes.name: _parse_block
nodes.summary: Recursively parses one indentation-delimited block of the constrained front-matter grammar into nested mappings, lists and scalars.

nodes.name: parse_document
nodes.summary: Splits a Markdown document into its --- delimited front matter and body, parsing the front matter into a metadata mapping.

nodes.name: FrontMatterError
nodes.summary: Error raised for malformed front matter, carrying the source document and line number for precise diagnostics.

nodes.name: initial_module_text
nodes.summary: Renders an honest four-part Module stub document (Purpose/Requirements/Scenarios/Ontology) for a freshly initialized project, naming only the known Project Spec/Developer/Framework authoring boundary rather than inventing business design.

nodes.name: project_proposal
nodes.summary: Builds the concorde-project-proposal file set (config.json, specs.json registry, module.md stub, and reflection/topology defaults) for initializing a new project.

nodes.name: apply_project_proposal
nodes.summary: Validates and applies a project initialization proposal's file set under an allow-list, verifying the resulting registry passes validation before committing the change.

nodes.name: Finding
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass representing one validation finding (rule_id, severity, source, message, remediation, optional line/column/subject_id), the common vocabulary every deterministic check reports through.

nodes.name: ProposalFile
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass representing one proposed file's path, content and sha256, used across proposal-generation flows.

nodes.name: ToolResult
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass representing the common outcome shape every Concorde Tool returns: tool name, target, status, artifacts, findings and an optional result payload.

nodes.name: digest
nodes.summary: Computes the canonical sha256:<hex> digest string used throughout the Spec system to identify file and value bytes.

nodes.name: read_file
nodes.summary: Reads a project-relative file's bytes through the safe checked-path boundary, raising SpecError for a missing or invalid path.

nodes.name: identifier
nodes.summary: Validates that a value matches the Protocol's lowercase-dot-hyphen identifier spelling rule.

nodes.name: entry_exists
nodes.summary: Checks whether a declared entity file entry (exact file or directory prefix) currently exists on disk.

nodes.name: expand_entry
nodes.summary: Expands one entity file entry into its concrete regular-file paths, walking a directory prefix and excluding the Protocol's fixed skip directories/suffixes.

nodes.name: walk_lines
nodes.summary: Iterates a document body's lines while tracking fenced-code-block state, yielding (line_number, text, in_fence) triples used by both parsing and validation.

nodes.name: _logical_lines
nodes.summary: Groups a document body's raw lines into logical (possibly fence-joined) lines for definition parsing.

nodes.name: _parse_definitions
nodes.summary: Parses requirement and scenario heading definitions (ID, title, statement/steps) out of one Module document's body, enforcing the Required Format grammar (SHALL statement shape, GIVEN/WHEN/THEN step ordering).

nodes.name: _parse_entities
nodes.summary: Parses concorde-entities JSON blocks within a document's Ontology/Entities subsection into SpecEntity records.

nodes.name: SpecError
nodes.summary: The common error type raised across Spec repository, validation and delivery code for a malformed, missing, or otherwise invalid Spec/registry condition, carrying a stable machine-readable code.

nodes.name: SpecTarget
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass representing one registered Module target (id, kind, title, documents, parent, uses, files, checks) as loaded from the registry.

nodes.name: SpecDocument
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass representing one loaded Markdown Spec document's path, content, digest and concorde-document metadata (targets, main_visible).

nodes.name: Requirement
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass representing one parsed requirement definition (id, title, statement, owning target, source document, line).

nodes.name: Scenario
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass representing one parsed scenario definition (id, title, owning target, source document, line, GIVEN/WHEN/THEN steps).

nodes.name: SpecEntity
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass representing one declared Module entity (id, title, kind, responsibility, files, pending, target_id, owner, document).

nodes.name: ModuleDefinitions
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass bundling one Module's parsed scenarios, requirements and entities together with an anchors() helper for identity lookups.

nodes.name: SpecRepository
nodes.summary: The central Spec repository class: loads and caches the project registry, resolves and validates Module targets, parses their documents into requirements/scenarios/entities, and answers dependency, file-listing, implementation-context and covering-Module queries.

nodes.name: admit
nodes.summary: Admits a JSON Schema object against Concorde's supported offline subset, rejecting unsupported assertion keywords and validating local-only $ref targets.

nodes.name: validate
nodes.summary: Validates a JSON value against an admitted schema (type, const, enum, object properties/required, array items/minItems/uniqueItems, string pattern/format), recursing through $ref and nested structures.

nodes.name: ContractError
nodes.summary: Error raised for a schema or value that fails admission or validation, carrying the offending field path.

nodes.name: canonical
nodes.summary: Serializes a value to canonical, sorted-key, separator-compact JSON text used for stable digests and comparisons.

nodes.name: decode
nodes.summary: Parses JSON text with strict duplicate-key and non-finite-number rejection, raising TypedDataError on malformed input.

nodes.name: check_schema
nodes.summary: Recursively validates a value against a DATA_SCHEMAS-referencing JSON Schema fragment (anyOf, $ref, type, const, enum, object/array/string constraints), the core admission check for every typed value.

nodes.name: safe_path
nodes.summary: Validates that a string is a canonical, safe, project-relative POSIX path (no backslashes, drive letters, control characters, leading slash, or . / .. segments).

nodes.name: checked_path
nodes.summary: Resolves a project-relative path to a concrete filesystem Path after validating it is safe and rejecting any symlink component, the shared path-safety boundary used across almost every file-touching operation.

nodes.name: typed
nodes.summary: Wraps a data payload into a validated TypedValue envelope (type_id, schema_version, data) for one type ID, the standard way every capability builds its output.

nodes.name: validate_typed
nodes.summary: Validates a TypedValue envelope's type_id, schema_version and schema-checked data, applying additional concorde-main-request action-specific field rules.

nodes.name: artifact
nodes.summary: Builds an artifact reference (id, path, digest) for one existing project file, the shared building block for citing evidence in a Tool result.

nodes.name: verify_artifacts
nodes.summary: Recursively walks a value for embedded artifact references and verifies each one's recorded digest still matches its current file bytes.

nodes.name: json_schema
nodes.summary: Exports a self-contained Draft 2020-12 JSON Schema document for one registered type ID, expanding $ref chains and the typed-task anyOf into inline $defs for tooling and documentation.

nodes.name: TypedDataError
nodes.summary: The common error type raised across the typed-data boundary for any invalid, unknown, unsupported, incompatible, or stale-reference condition, exposing a to_dict() form for typed error responses.

nodes.name: validation.py
nodes.summary: Deterministic Spec/registry checks that establish structural and contract evidence (mandatory sections, requirement/scenario syntax, entity file listings, relationship diagrams, dependency promises, scenario verification) without ever proving semantic completeness.
nodes.languageNotes: Explicitly documents the boundary between deterministic structural checks and unprovable semantic completeness of a Spec.

nodes.name: verification.py
nodes.summary: Defines the @verifies decorator tests use to declare which scenario IDs they exercise, and a static AST-based scanner that reads those declarations from Python files without importing or executing them.

nodes.name: wire_shapes.py
nodes.summary: Dependency-free JSON Schema shape builders (obj, array, typed_schema) and primitive shapes (STRING, PATH, DIGEST, ARTIFACT) that every other schema-definition module in the package builds on.

nodes.name: docsite_scaffold.py
nodes.summary: Preview-first scaffold flow that proposes and then applies the packaged docsite adapter template into an initialized project, resolving site identity (title, repository, base URL) and detecting deployment prerequisites.

nodes.name: docsite_template.py
nodes.summary: Single source of truth for which bytes under docsite/ travel as the packaged adapter template, used identically by the installer and the scaffold Tool so a project always receives the same adapter Concorde runs for its own site.

nodes.name: flowchart_model
nodes.summary: Parses one Mermaid flowchart/graph fence into its node-label and labeled-edge model, used to check Relationship diagram entity coverage.

nodes.name: _section_ranges
nodes.summary: Splits a document body into ATX-heading-delimited section ranges at a given level, used to locate the four mandatory Module sections.

nodes.name: _ontology_subsections
nodes.summary: Locates the Entities and Relationships ATX subsections within a Module's Ontology section.

nodes.name: _fences_in_range
nodes.summary: Collects fenced code blocks of a given language within a line range, used to find concorde-entities and mermaid fences.

nodes.name: module_findings
nodes.summary: Checks that a Module's reading entry contains the four mandatory ATX sections in order and that its Ontology contains exactly the required Entities/Relationships subsections.

nodes.name: definition_findings
nodes.summary: Checks requirement and scenario heading definitions for correct ID spelling, uniqueness, statement shape (exactly one SHALL/SHALL NOT), and step-keyword ordering.

nodes.name: architecture_findings
nodes.summary: Checks that a Module's Relationships Mermaid diagrams use exactly its declared entity titles as nodes and that every edge carries a label.

nodes.name: unlisted_file_findings
nodes.summary: Reports implementation files present under a Module's owned directories that are not listed by any of its entities.

nodes.name: document_context_findings
nodes.summary: Checks registered document collection consistency: exactly one local module.md reading entry per Module, and mutual agreement of concorde-document targets with registry document membership.

nodes.name: module_dependency_findings
nodes.summary: Checks that concorde-dependencies declarations agree exactly with the registry's uses/parent relationships and each entry carries nonempty responsibility/selection_condition/relied_upon_promises.

nodes.name: link_findings
nodes.summary: Checks that local Markdown links whose fragment looks like a scenario/requirement/entity ID resolve to an actual definition in the linked document.

nodes.name: verification_findings
nodes.summary: Cross-checks scenario verification: reports tests that declare an unknown scenario, tests whose file isn't listed by the scenario's owning Module, and scenarios no test declares.

nodes.name: validate_repository
nodes.summary: The main deterministic validation entry point: loads the repository, cross-checks contract provider/requirer agreement, runs every structural finding check, validates reflection attribution and package distribution when applicable, and returns a ToolResult with a source digest.

nodes.name: DiagramError
nodes.summary: Error raised for a malformed Mermaid flowchart fence encountered while building the relationship diagram model.

nodes.name: verifies
nodes.summary: Decorator factory that records the scenario IDs a test function or method verifies as a concorde_scenarios attribute, without altering the test's runtime behavior.

nodes.name: _declarations
nodes.summary: Statically walks a parsed Python AST for @verifies-decorated function/method definitions and yields their declared Verification records.

nodes.name: scan_declarations
nodes.summary: Parses every Python file in a path set via ast.parse (without importing or executing it) and returns every declared Verification record, raising DeclarationError on a syntax failure.

nodes.name: Verification
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass representing one @verifies declaration: the scenario_id it names plus the declaring test's path, line and name.

nodes.name: DeclarationError
nodes.summary: Error raised when a Python file the scanner must read fails to parse, carrying the offending path and line.

nodes.name: obj
nodes.summary: Builds a JSON Schema object shape from a properties mapping, defaulting every property to required except those named optional; the most widely reused schema-building primitive in the codebase.

nodes.name: array
nodes.summary: Builds a JSON Schema array shape from an items schema, optionally requiring unique items.

nodes.name: typed_schema
nodes.summary: Builds the standard TypedValue envelope schema (type_id const, schema_version const 1, data $ref) for one type ID.

nodes.name: _origin_repository
nodes.summary: Parses the local .git/config file to recover the GitHub owner/repo URL from the origin remote, supporting both SSH and HTTPS remote URL forms.

nodes.name: _validate_identity_inputs
nodes.summary: Validates the combination of explicit title/repository/url/base_url overrides supplied to propose_docsite, collecting human-readable error messages.

nodes.name: _resolve_identity
nodes.summary: Resolves the final site identity (title, repository URL, base URL) from explicit overrides and detected Git origin, producing a Finding when a value could not be inferred.

nodes.name: _proposal_entries
nodes.summary: Builds the list of template file entries (path, content, source) to propose, substituting the resolved site identity into the site.json entry and optionally including the GitHub Pages workflow.

nodes.name: _detect_prerequisites
nodes.summary: Detects the project's readiness for docsite deployment (Git repository present, GitHub remote configured, gh CLI available) via filesystem and subprocess probes.

nodes.name: _prerequisite_findings
nodes.summary: Converts detected prerequisite gaps into human-readable Findings guiding the developer toward a working docsite deployment.

nodes.name: propose_docsite
nodes.summary: Public Tool entry point that resolves site identity, validates the packaged template root, builds the proposed file set and conflict list, and returns a preview ToolResult without touching the project.

nodes.name: _load_accepted
nodes.summary: Loads and re-verifies a previously accepted docsite proposal JSON file against the current package template bytes, recomputing each file's content from its declared source or literal content and checking its digest.

nodes.name: apply_docsite
nodes.summary: Public Tool entry point that promotes an accepted docsite proposal's exact file set onto disk, refusing to overwrite any changed or conflicting target.

nodes.name: _walk
nodes.summary: Recursively yields regular files under a directory prefix, excluding node_modules/build/.generated/.docusaurus/coverage/tests-repository and dotfile entries.

nodes.name: verify_package_root
nodes.summary: Verifies the installed package's docsite/ template root exists and contains the expected top-level entries, raising DocsiteTemplateError otherwise.

nodes.name: template_files
nodes.summary: Walks the full docsite/ template root and returns every included file's relative path mapped to its bytes, applying the allowed-suffix and excluded-directory/file rules.

nodes.name: adapter_files
nodes.summary: Returns the subset of template_files excluding the scaffold-only directories, i.e. exactly the bytes the installer ships as the adapter.

nodes.name: workflow_template
nodes.summary: Returns the GitHub Pages deploy workflow template file's bytes from the package template root.

nodes.name: template_digest
nodes.summary: Computes a stable combined sha256 digest over a file-name-to-bytes mapping, used to detect template drift between a proposal and the current package.

nodes.name: DocsiteTemplateError
nodes.summary: Error raised when the packaged docsite template root is missing, incomplete, or otherwise invalid.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package-level inventory for Concorde's Agent modules -- declares the canonical AGENTS tuple naming every agents/<name>/ subpackage and derives each Agent's public concorde-<hyphenated-name> skill identity.
nodes.languageNotes: Docstring documents a validator-enforced invariant (CONCORDE-AGENT-INVENTORY-001): every name in AGENTS must have a matching agents/<name>/__init__.py package and vice versa.

nodes.name: external_name
nodes.summary: Converts an Agent module name (e.g. spec_author) into its public concorde-<hyphenated> skill identity string.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Defines the code_reviewer Agent: an independent, read-only code-review Agent bound to the IMPLEMENTATION_WORKSPACE harness with review-stage context and result contracts.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Defines the context_assessor Agent, which decides whether a task is resolvable from the admitted Spec context, bound to the SPEC_CAPSULE harness.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Defines the coordinator Agent, which answers questions from complete Spec contexts, routes work, and designs system topology, bound to the DISCOVERY_CAPSULE harness.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Defines the implementation_worker Agent, which fulfils task acceptance under a host-granted code boundary, bound to the IMPLEMENTATION_WORKSPACE harness with write access to implementation files.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Defines the planner Agent, which plans contract-level work purely from the Spec, bound to the SPEC_CAPSULE harness.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Defines the spec_author Agent, which reconciles a target's complete Markdown Spec collection and diagrams, bound to the SPEC_CAPSULE harness with topology-authoring context and result contracts.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Defines the spec_reviewer Agent, an independent, read-only Spec-review Agent bound to the SPEC_CAPSULE harness.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Defines the task_author Agent, which turns an accepted plan into tasks with observable acceptance conditions, bound to the SPEC_CAPSULE harness.

nodes.name: context_solve.py
nodes.summary: Internal stage capability that assesses a task for missing Spec information within one frozen context, delegating to the context_assessor Agent; never exposed as a user-invocable Skill.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Entry point that dispatches the context_solve stage request to the shared run_capability service using this module's derived external identity.

nodes.name: dev_loop.py
nodes.summary: Global development-loop capability that routes a target through specify, review, plan, tasks, implement and validate to reach a ready candidate, with a bounded (max_repair_iterations=2) automatic review_code -> tasks repair edge.
nodes.languageNotes: GRAPH['max_repair_iterations'] documents the sole bounded automatic revision edge (review_code -> tasks), recorded per target in .concorde/worktree.json so a resumed loop reuses its starting policy.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Entry point that dispatches the dev_loop request to the shared run_capability service.

nodes.name: implement.py
nodes.summary: Internal stage capability that implements or investigates tasks under a host-granted code boundary, delegating to the implementation_worker Agent; never exposed as a user-invocable Skill.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Entry point that dispatches the implement stage request to the shared run_capability service.

nodes.name: main.py
nodes.summary: Global entry capability that answers questions, routes work, and designs or applies system topology, combining the coordinator and spec_author Agents behind an ask/design-topology/accept-topology/apply-topology action contract.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Entry point that dispatches the main capability request to the shared run_capability service.

nodes.name: plan.py
nodes.summary: Internal stage capability that plans a change from one complete Spec without implementation access, combining the context_assessor and planner Agents; never exposed as a user-invocable Skill.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Entry point that dispatches the plan stage request to the shared run_capability service.

nodes.name: reflections_triage.py
nodes.summary: Global reflection-queue capability that reports status, captures recorded gaps, and investigates, implements, merges or closes owned reflections, reusing the dev_loop capability for implementation.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Entry point that dispatches the reflections_triage request to the shared run_capability service.

nodes.name: review.py
nodes.summary: Global capability that routes an observational task and then independently reviews its Spec or code read-only, combining the spec_reviewer and code_reviewer Agents behind a spec/code review_mode contract.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Entry point that dispatches the review request to the shared run_capability service.

nodes.name: specify.py
nodes.summary: Internal stage capability that authors the selected target's complete Spec documents, delegating to the spec_author Agent; never exposed as a user-invocable Skill.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Entry point that dispatches the specify stage request to the shared run_capability service.

nodes.name: tasks.py
nodes.summary: Internal stage capability that turns an admitted plan into tasks with observable acceptance conditions, delegating to the task_author Agent; never exposed as a user-invocable Skill.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Entry point that dispatches the tasks stage request to the shared run_capability service.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Empty package marker that makes tests/concorde/development a discoverable Python package for pytest/unittest collection.

nodes.name: test_check_execution.py
nodes.summary: Integration tests proving Development's check execution uses the real Harness sandbox without granting log-write access to checks, covering forged-log rejection, real project validation failures, unavailable sandbox blocking, timeout output retention, and digest invalidation on external host changes.

nodes.name: test_review.py
nodes.summary: Very large suite covering Concorde's review capability end to end: review modes, scope/write-grant rules, diff admission, gap/finding capture and dedup, review freshness, required-review gating of the dev loop, domain review aggregation, and a repair loop that resumes and reaches ready after blocking feedback.
nodes.languageNotes: Process doubles are used throughout instead of real model calls; the file docstring explicitly warns they do not measure semantic review quality, only mechanism correctness.

nodes.name: test_standalone_review.py
nodes.summary: Tests that public standalone review is routed through Studio's shared executable boundary without creating a change, and that its preview and blocked routes never launch a reviewer or widen scope.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Empty package marker that makes tests/concorde/harness a discoverable Python package for pytest/unittest collection.

nodes.name: test_agent_binding.py
nodes.summary: Reproduces the R-066 design-review probe and exercises Agent-binding wiring: every launch binds an Agent definition and derives effective write authority and loop timeout from it, a narrowed implementation Agent's write authority is never widened, and cancelled/limit-exhausted executor outcomes map to distinct wire codes and recorded change statuses.

nodes.name: test_agent_model.py
nodes.summary: Directly exercises agent_model.resolve_agent, the harness(...) digest it depends on, and the build.load_agent wrapper: digest stability/uniqueness across the registered harnesses, successful resolution for every inventory agent after a build, and fail-closed rejection of invalid agent bindings (widened effects, unregistered harness, unknown capability, unadmitted context, wrong spec path, widened timeout).

nodes.name: test_agent_runtime.py
nodes.summary: Exercises real host/context admission and recursive Agent control flow with explicit process doubles standing in for native decisions: nested code/model chains, self-call denial before context admission, host allowlisting and target attenuation, cancellation, deadlines, error sanitization, spec-freshness byte comparison, and native Codex/Claude handoff to code-driven agents.

nodes.name: test_boundaries.py
nodes.summary: Behavioral regression gates replacing the old Profile 7 ambient/ancestor context contracts: shared document identity and truth, directory listing via explicit trailing slash, protocol tampering detection, configuration authority, read-only describe/ask policies, atomic file-replacement rollback on failed verification, and explicit rejection of a silent Profile 7 downgrade.
nodes.languageNotes: setUp and several assertions use terse semicolon-joined one-liners, an intentionally compact style distinct from the rest of the suite.

nodes.name: test_scoped_protocol.py
nodes.summary: Very large suite validating scoped Spec Protocol behavior: module dependency and context solving, document identity/membership validation, concorde-main direct answers and topology design/accept/apply as one atomic operation, discovery-context digest binding, global-vs-internal stage capability rules, and a standard loop that reaches a ready change through real checks.

nodes.name: test_studio.py
nodes.summary: Tests Studio's LangGraph execution graph against the real capability host with deterministic model responses: inventory/context execution parity, streamed agent stage events, resumed-thread state clearing, cross-workspace and invalid-envelope rejection, UTF-8 input limits, and symlink-root rejection; also defines the invocation/stable fixture helpers reused across other Studio test files.

nodes.name: test_studio_client.py
nodes.summary: Tests the Studio HTTP client (run_in_studio), asserting transport failures never duplicate a capability invocation or contaminate JSON stdout, including remote/redirect URL rejection, no retry or local fallback after connection loss, and rejection of incompatible results.

nodes.name: test_studio_server.py
nodes.summary: Opt-in integration tests (CONCORDE_TEST_STUDIO=1) that launch a real Agent Server subprocess and drive it over HTTP and the CLI skill launcher, checking schema parity across every public assistant, live streamed events with a persisted result, workspace guard enforcement, and thread reset after an invalid envelope.

nodes.name: test_worktree_lifecycle.py
nodes.summary: Very large suite of real Git regressions for worktree ownership, awareness and recovery: primary/secondary handoff, pending-file confirmation at delivery, primary merge and rollback on conflicts, cleanup retry and interrupted-cleanup resumption, and rejection of a second concurrent or redirected change worktree.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses real git subprocess calls and a ThreadPoolExecutor to exercise concurrent worktree creation rather than mocking git.

nodes.name: test_scope_and_reflections.py
nodes.summary: Tests Domain-scoped reflection triage: a Domain coordinates separate component contexts, rejects a component outside its scope, retains a component gap and stops before code, and read-only investigation preserves the user's original report while rejecting the wrong head.

nodes.name: support.py
nodes.summary: Shared test-fixture module for the Profile 11 boundary: builds the 'Bank' fixture project (Banking/Audit/Transfers/Ledger targets and their Spec documents), Markdown Module-document builders, and ModelProcessDouble, an explicit process double standing in for the Codex/Claude model process used across most of the Harness and Spec test suites.
nodes.languageNotes: Central shared fixture consumed by nearly every other file in this batch; changes here ripple across the whole harness/spec/development test suites.

nodes.name: test_distribution.py
nodes.summary: Tests the installed package's distributed surface: the capability catalog's roles and exported schemas are executable contracts, self-architecture lists every implementation file under an entity, the launcher refuses raw stage capability names, the full installed framework runs its real graph and checks for both integrations, and a prior completion cannot be replayed.

nodes.name: test_module_architecture.py
nodes.summary: Tests Spec Protocol 3.0's reading entry: the inline Mermaid architecture diagram and entity listings, context invalidation when either changes, per-document authoring boundaries between spec author and foreign documents, atomic authoring/application of a brand-new module's own topology, and honest rollback when initial project setup writes a bad reading entry.

nodes.name: CheckIntegrationTests
nodes.summary: unittest.TestCase verifying the check-execution sandbox cannot forge logs, blocks execution when no sandbox is available without leaking private diagnostics, retains output and status on timeout, and that a host-persisted digest is invalidated by external host changes.

nodes.name: ReviewTests
nodes.summary: Large unittest.TestCase covering the review capability's modes, scope-limited diffs, gap/finding capture and deduplication, review freshness across spec/code/intent/artifact integrity, required reviews around planning, fast-loop skip recording, and domain review aggregation and resumption.

nodes.name: RepairLoopTests
nodes.summary: unittest.TestCase for the AI-driven repair loop: a blocking-then-clean cycle repairs once and reaches ready, unchanged or repeatedly-different blocking feedback stops waiting at the declared limit, a spec gap in spec review stops waiting before planning, and a capability execution error during standalone code review maps to an execution limit.

nodes.name: StandaloneReviewTests
nodes.summary: unittest.TestCase verifying public standalone review routes without creating a change while preserving read-only scope, and that its preview and blocked routes never launch a reviewer.

nodes.name: AgentBindingTests
nodes.summary: unittest.TestCase proving a narrowed implementation Agent's declared write authority is never widened at execution time, that describe-policy exposes bound Agent/Harness identity and a matching binding digest, that the executor receives the Agent's effective loop timeout, and that limit/cancellation outcomes map to distinct wire codes and recorded change statuses.

nodes.name: HarnessDigestTests
nodes.summary: unittest.TestCase asserting Harness digests are stable and order-independent, and change exactly when loop timeout, a context, or effects change, with each of the three registered harnesses producing a distinct digest.

nodes.name: ResolveAgentBuildTests
nodes.summary: unittest.TestCase confirming resolve_agent succeeds for every agent in the inventory after a fresh write_build, accepts external hyphenated/underscored agent names, fails closed on unknown agents or a missing rendered-instructions (stale) build, and that the effective loop and load_agent_binding/effects match resolve_agent's output.

nodes.name: ResolveAgentInvalidBindingTests
nodes.summary: unittest.TestCase enumerating invalid Agent bindings that resolve_agent must reject: constraints widening effects beyond the harness, an unregistered harness, an unknown capability reference, a context not admitted by the harness, a wrong spec path, and limits widening the harness timeout, plus the valid tighter-timeout case.

nodes.name: AgentRuntimeTests
nodes.summary: Very large unittest.TestCase for recursive Agent execution: nested code/model/code chains with private fresh frames, self-call denial before context admission, host allowlisting and target attenuation, invalid child input as typed failure feedback, shared limit propagation, cancellation and deadline handling, sanitized error recovery, gap/waiting provenance, and native Codex/Claude decision handoff to code-driven agents.

nodes.name: BoundaryTests
nodes.summary: unittest.TestCase for Profile 11 boundary regressions: shared physical Markdown as one-hop context rather than entity expansion, single-target authors unable to change collective shared truth or duplicate document identity, explicit trailing-slash directory listing, protocol tampering and configuration-authority invalidation, read-only describe/ask policies, atomic file-replacement rollback, and explicit rejection of a silent Profile 7 downgrade.

nodes.name: ScopedProtocolTests
nodes.summary: Very large unittest.TestCase validating scoped Spec Protocol behavior: module dependency resolution and context solving, document identity/membership validation, concorde-main direct answers and atomic topology design/accept/apply, discovery-context digest binding, global-vs-internal stage capability rules, and a standard loop that reaches a ready change through real behavioral checks.

nodes.name: StudioTests
nodes.summary: unittest.TestCase exercising Studio's LangGraph execution boundary with the real host: inventory-entry execution matches local JSON, streamed agent stages use the native executor with fresh invocations, resumed threads clear results and recheck the workspace, cross-workspace/invalid envelopes never construct an execution host, and symlink roots are rejected.

nodes.name: StudioClientTests
nodes.summary: unittest.TestCase for the Studio HTTP client rejecting remote/redirect URLs, never retrying or falling back locally after a connection loss, preserving the server result across polling, and rejecting an incompatible result shape.

nodes.name: StudioServerTests
nodes.summary: Opt-in unittest.TestCase that launches a real Agent Server subprocess and checks schema parity between direct execution and the CLI skill launcher, live streamed process stages with a persisted result, workspace-mismatch blocking before any operation event, and thread reset after an invalid envelope.

nodes.name: WorktreeLifecycleTests
nodes.summary: Very large unittest.TestCase of real Git regressions for the worktree lifecycle: primary sees secondary draft identity, failed delivery preserves task gaps, primary/secondary handoff as one JSON response, pending-file confirmation at delivery, primary merge with rollback on conflicts, cleanup retry and resumption after interruption, and rejection of a second concurrent or redirected change worktree.

nodes.name: ScopeReflectionTests
nodes.summary: unittest.TestCase for Domain-scoped reflection triage: coordinating separate component contexts, rejecting a component outside the domain's scope, retaining a component gap before code, exposing status without record body or code, and read-only investigation that preserves the user's report and rejects the wrong head.

nodes.name: ModelProcessDouble
nodes.summary: Explicit process double standing in for the Codex/Claude model process boundary: fabricates a fake runtime executable, records every invocation, and returns scripted or callback-driven responses so tests can assert precisely on host/model interaction without a real model.

nodes.name: DistributionTests
nodes.summary: unittest.TestCase asserting the installed package's capability catalog roles and exported schemas are executable contracts, self-architecture lists every implementation file under an entity, the launcher refuses a raw stage capability name while accepting a public skill, the installed framework runs a complete real graph with checks for both integrations, and a prior completion cannot be replayed.

nodes.name: ModuleArchitectureTests
nodes.summary: unittest.TestCase for the Spec Protocol reading entry: complete context ignores visibility with the architecture heading outside fences, a Mermaid flowchart is required in the Ontology section, diagram nodes must equal entity titles with every edge labeled, an entity can only stand for a child or used module, inline-diagram or entity-listing changes invalidate an existing context, a spec author can update only its own document, an invalid diagram rolls the whole document back, and a brand-new module authors and applies its own topology.

nodes.name: InitialModuleTests
nodes.summary: unittest.TestCase verifying that project initialization is honest and rolls back cleanly when the generated initial reading entry is bad, rather than leaving a partially valid Module in place.

nodes.name: update_document_declaration
nodes.summary: Rewrites a Spec document's concorde-document JSON block in place with the given field updates (e.g. targets, main_visible), used by tests to mutate document metadata directly on disk.

nodes.name: module_document
nodes.summary: Builds a complete four-part Module reading-entry document (Purpose, Requirements, Scenarios, and an Ontology with Entities/Relationships) as Markdown text from the given fixture pieces, optionally appending a Collaborators section from dependency declarations.

nodes.name: project
nodes.summary: Builds and writes the shared 'Bank' fixture project (Banking/Audit/Transfers/Ledger targets, their Spec documents, transfer/ledger app code, and a transfer check) into a temporary root, returning the registry that most Harness, Development and Spec tests build on.

nodes.name: invocation
nodes.summary: Builds a canonical concorde-capability-invocation payload for a given capability, mode and data, defaulting to a transfer-target reflections-triage request; reused as a fixture helper by other Studio-related test files.

nodes.name: stable
nodes.summary: Deep-copies a result value and strips its non-deterministic invocation_id, so results from separate host runs with different invocation identities can still be compared for equality in assertions.

nodes.name: visual-check.mjs
nodes.summary: Drives headless Chrome over the DevTools Protocol pipe to visually verify a rendered Archify HTML artifact, checking desktop containment and readability, capturing themed screenshots, and writing a JSON receipt plus a contact-sheet HTML page.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements a minimal CDP client (PipeCdp) directly over Chrome's stdio pipe file descriptors instead of a WebSocket, avoiding any external browser-automation dependency.

nodes.name: sidecarPaths
nodes.summary: Computes the deterministic sidecar file paths (screenshots, receipt, contact sheet) derived from an artifact's path so repeated visual checks overwrite the same outputs.

nodes.name: findOnPath
nodes.summary: Searches the directories listed in PATH, respecting PATHEXT on Windows, for the first executable matching a given command name.

nodes.name: findChrome
nodes.summary: Locates a usable Chrome or Chromium executable by checking the ARCHIFY_CHROME environment variable, common install locations, then falling back to a PATH search.

nodes.name: chromeVisualBrowserArgs
nodes.summary: Builds the Chrome launch argument list for headless visual checking, disabling the sandbox only when running as root or via an explicit opt-in environment variable.

nodes.name: evaluate
nodes.summary: Sends a Runtime.evaluate CDP command through a PipeCdp session and unwraps the result, throwing on any exception reported by the browser.

nodes.name: observation
nodes.summary: Normalizes raw layout and readability values captured from the browser into a structured observation record used to build the visual check receipt.

nodes.name: contactSheetHtml
nodes.summary: Renders an HTML contact sheet embedding all captured screenshots with pass/fail containment captions for quick visual review of a check run.

nodes.name: baseReceipt
nodes.summary: Assembles the initial JSON receipt structure for a visual check run, recording the artifact hash, Chrome executable status, and default pass/fail sections.

nodes.name: runVisualCheck
nodes.summary: Top-level orchestration entry point that resolves Chrome, launches a ChromeVisualBrowser, inspects the artifact at every configured viewport and theme, aggregates containment and readability results, writes screenshots and a contact sheet, and persists the final receipt.

nodes.name: PipeCdp
nodes.summary: Minimal Chrome DevTools Protocol client that frames JSON messages over Chrome's NUL-delimited pipe file descriptors, tracking pending request promises and waiters for asynchronous CDP events.

nodes.name: ChromeVisualBrowser
nodes.summary: Launches a sandboxed headless Chrome process wired to a PipeCdp session, attaches to its page target, and exposes attach/inspect/close methods for navigating to and measuring a rendered artifact.

nodes.name: desktop-readability.mjs
nodes.summary: Shared constants and pure math helpers defining the desktop adaptive-reader viewport and the minimum projected node-label text size considered readable.

nodes.name: projectedNodeTextPx
nodes.summary: Projects a source SVG font size down to its rendered pixel size at the desktop reader's fixed diagram width.

nodes.name: minimumReadableSourceTextPx
nodes.summary: Computes the minimum source font size, the inverse of projectedNodeTextPx, that still satisfies the minimum readable projected text size at a given viewBox width.

nodes.name: check-render-output.mjs
nodes.summary: Standalone CLI script that statically analyzes a rendered Archify diagram's SVG markup for composition quality: relationship crossings, ambiguous routing corridors, legend collisions, label clearance, and desktop text readability, then prints a JSON verdict.
nodes.languageNotes: Parses SVG geometry with hand-rolled regex and string scanning rather than a DOM or SVG path library, computing segment intersections and bounding boxes directly.

nodes.name: collectArrows
nodes.summary: Extracts every relationship arrow's endpoints, style class, and border segments from the rendered SVG fragment for downstream crossing and clearance checks.

nodes.name: collectRelationshipLabelMasks
nodes.summary: Locates each relationship label's masking rectangle in the SVG and associates it with its owning arrow for label and route clearance analysis.

nodes.name: collectRelationshipCrossings
nodes.summary: Detects pairs of non-sibling relationship arrows whose border segments properly intersect, flagging ambiguous visual crossings.

nodes.name: relationshipRecord
nodes.summary: Builds a normalized crossing-report record, including names, bend counts, and endpoints, describing one detected relationship-arrow crossing.

nodes.name: collectCompositionFrames
nodes.summary: Extracts composition and boundary frame rectangles and their border segments from the SVG for use in border-run and containment checks.

nodes.name: straightPathSegments
nodes.summary: Parses an SVG path's d attribute into a sequence of straight line segments, handling move/line/cubic-curve commands and near-diagonal simplification.

nodes.name: collectLegendBoxes
nodes.summary: Collects the bounding boxes of legend swatches and text labels rendered in the SVG so they can be checked against relationship routes for collisions.

nodes.name: collectLegendCollisions
nodes.summary: Flags legend boxes that intersect any relationship arrow's padded border segments, indicating a visual overlap that should be avoided.

nodes.name: textBox
nodes.summary: Estimates a text label's bounding box from its SVG attributes and rendered string using an approximate character-width model.

nodes.name: collectDesktopReadability
nodes.summary: Scans node and boundary labels in the SVG at the desktop reader's viewBox width and reports the smallest projected text size against the configured readability floor.

nodes.name: pointsFromPath
nodes.summary: Tokenizes and evaluates an SVG path d string into an ordered list of absolute points, supporting move, line, and cubic Bezier commands.

nodes.name: properSegmentIntersection
nodes.summary: Determines whether two line segments cross at an interior point, a proper geometric intersection excluding shared endpoints.

nodes.name: segmentIntersectsBox
nodes.summary: Tests whether a line segment intersects or lies inside an axis-aligned bounding box.

nodes.name: segmentsIntersect
nodes.summary: Classic orientation-based test for whether two line segments intersect, including collinear overlap cases.

nodes.name: adaptive-reader-layout.test.mjs
nodes.summary: Node test-runner suite asserting the adaptive desktop reader shell in the HTML template uses one height-budgeted layout instead of breakpoint jumps, and that its readability constants and math match the shared desktop-readability module.

nodes.name: desktop-reader-browser.test.mjs
nodes.summary: Real-Chrome regression test that renders a production showcase architecture diagram and runs the full visual check three times, asserting the desktop reader stays at its expected readable width and text size. Skips automatically unless ARCHIFY_CHROME is set.

nodes.name: i18n.test.mjs
nodes.summary: Node test-runner suite verifying that rendering every diagram type in zh-CN localizes renderer-owned chrome (legend, viewer nav, labels) via the i18n catalog while leaving author-written content untranslated, using both static HTML and live Chrome rendering.

nodes.name: authoredExample
nodes.summary: Deep-walks an example diagram document and replaces every author-owned text field with locale-tagged placeholder copy, so translation tests can distinguish authored text from renderer-owned chrome.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Invokes the Archify CLI (render or validate) against a temporary input document and returns the process result along with the rendered HTML.

nodes.name: evaluate
nodes.summary: Evaluates a JavaScript expression inside the attached Chrome page via CDP and returns its resolved value, throwing on any evaluation exception.

nodes.name: loadArtifact
nodes.summary: Navigates the headless Chrome session to a rendered HTML artifact at a fixed desktop viewport and waits for two animation frames before returning the session id.

nodes.name: semantic-radar.test.mjs
nodes.summary: Real-Chrome test suite exercising the semantic radar overlay across every diagram type, checking that radar rectangles render correctly and that dragging the radar does not cause overlapping regions.

nodes.name: evaluate
nodes.summary: Evaluates a JavaScript expression in the attached Chrome page via CDP, unwrapping the result or throwing on an evaluation exception.

nodes.name: loadArtifact
nodes.summary: Loads a rendered diagram artifact into the headless Chrome session at a fixed viewport and waits for layout to stabilize before returning the session id.

nodes.name: radarRects
nodes.summary: Drives the semantic radar overlay's setup interaction in the browser and reads back the resulting highlighted rectangle geometries.

nodes.name: dragMouse
nodes.summary: Simulates a mouse drag gesture inside the Chrome page via synthesized CDP input events, moving from one point to another in interpolated steps.

nodes.name: viewer-chrome-layout.test.mjs
nodes.summary: Real-Chrome test suite verifying the viewer chrome (legend panel and navigation dock) lays out without collisions or overflow across every diagram type after the page reaches a stable layout.

nodes.name: render
nodes.summary: Renders a diagram example through the Archify CLI into a temporary HTML file and returns its contents for browser-based layout verification.

nodes.name: evaluate
nodes.summary: Evaluates a JavaScript expression in the attached Chrome page via CDP, unwrapping the result or throwing on an evaluation exception.

nodes.name: waitForLayout
nodes.summary: Polls the rendered page in the browser until the viewer chrome (legend, nav dock) reaches a stable, settled layout before measurements are taken.

nodes.name: finalGeometry
nodes.summary: Reads back the final measured geometry of the legend, navigation dock, and diagram viewport from the browser after layout has stabilized.

nodes.name: load
nodes.summary: Navigates the headless Chrome session to a rendered artifact and waits for it to finish loading before returning the session id.

nodes.name: visual-check.test.mjs
nodes.summary: Unit test suite for visual-check.mjs's pure and mockable logic, covering sandbox argument selection, receipt and sidecar handling, and full runVisualCheck orchestration, using fake browser and Chrome child-process doubles instead of a real browser.

nodes.name: fakeBrowser
nodes.summary: Constructs a mock browser double implementing inspect/close that records calls and can be parametrized to simulate overflow, unreadable text, viewer-chrome collisions, or screenshot failures.

nodes.name: fakeChromeChild
nodes.summary: Builds a fake Chrome child-process object with stdio streams and a kill() method that emits exit and close events, used to test process lifecycle handling without spawning real Chrome.

nodes.name: open-artifact.mjs
nodes.summary: Cross-platform helper that opens a local artifact path or a strict loopback preview URL using the OS-native opener (open/xdg-open/PowerShell Start-Process) without shell interpolation.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a platform-keyed opener table and passes arguments as an array with shell:false, so untrusted paths are never interpolated into a shell command string.

nodes.name: preview.mjs
nodes.summary: Implements Archify's live preview dev server: serves a loopback HTTP+SSE page, watches the diagram input file, rebuilds it through the archify CLI's `deliver` command on change, and republishes verified/needs-fix state to connected clients.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses debounced fs.watch plus a polling fallback and hash/epoch bookkeeping to coordinate concurrent rebuild generations so a stale in-flight build never clobbers a newer verified result.

nodes.name: output-path.mjs
nodes.summary: Resolves and validates the output file path for a generated diagram, following symlinks and filesystem case/Unicode alias semantics to reject unsafe targets (absolute meta.output, wrong extension, escaping cwd, aliasing an input or another output).
nodes.languageNotes: Implements manual symlink-aware path canonicalization and directory alias probing (case sensitivity, Unicode normalization) via temporary probe files, since Node's fs.realpathSync cannot resolve paths that do not yet exist.

nodes.name: open-artifact.test.mjs
nodes.summary: Tests that openArtifact and openLoopbackUrl invoke platform-specific openers via argument arrays (no shell interpolation) and that openLoopbackUrl rejects any URL that is not a bare http://127.0.0.1:<port> loopback root.

nodes.name: output-path.test.mjs
nodes.summary: Integration tests for output path resolution: future-path aliasing under directory case/Unicode semantics, symlink cycles, meta.output validation, and end-to-end behavior through the preview server, CLI, and shared output-path helpers.

nodes.name: preview.test.mjs
nodes.summary: Integration tests for the live preview server covering startup rejection of destructive/unsupported targets, state polling over the /events and /state endpoints, and raw HTTP request handling.

nodes.name: repository-evidence.test.mjs
nodes.summary: Integration tests verifying that `archify deliver` embeds repository source-evidence metadata (remote URL forms, commit revision, file references) into the generated diagram HTML when a diagram's components declare `sources`.

nodes.name: launchTarget

nodes.name: openArtifact

nodes.name: openLoopbackUrl

nodes.name: initialAuthoredOutput

nodes.name: previewPage

nodes.name: compactMessage
nodes.summary: Trims a raw diagnostic/error string down to its leading `Error:` line and stack-free body, truncating overly long output for display.

nodes.name: responseHeaders
nodes.summary: Builds the fixed set of hardened HTTP response headers (no-store cache control, same-origin CORP, frame/content-type protections) applied to every preview server response.

nodes.name: startPreview
nodes.summary: Core exported preview engine: resolves the output path, starts a loopback HTTP server with SSE state broadcasting, watches and polls the input file, debounces rebuilds through the archify CLI's deliver subprocess, commits verified artifacts atomically, and exposes stop/closed lifecycle controls.

nodes.name: runPreview
nodes.summary: Exported CLI wrapper that starts the preview server, logs the URL/input/output, wires SIGINT/SIGTERM to a graceful-then-forced stop, and awaits server shutdown.

nodes.name: canonicalize
nodes.summary: Resolves a path to its real filesystem location by walking each path segment and following symbolic links, detecting and erroring on symlink cycles.

nodes.name: canonicalFuturePath
nodes.summary: Exported wrapper around canonicalize that resolves a path's real location even when parts of it do not yet exist, converting a detected symlink cycle into a structured OutputPathError.

nodes.name: nearestExistingDirectory
nodes.summary: Walks up a target path's ancestors to find and return the nearest directory that currently exists on disk, used to probe filesystem alias semantics for not-yet-created paths.

nodes.name: probeNamesAlias
nodes.summary: Determines whether two candidate file names inside a directory refer to the same underlying file identity by creating, statting, and cleaning up a temporary probe file.

nodes.name: probeDirectorySemantics
nodes.summary: Detects and caches whether a directory's filesystem treats names as case-insensitive and/or Unicode-normalization-insensitive, using probeNamesAlias.

nodes.name: futurePathsAlias
nodes.summary: Determines whether two paths that may not yet exist would resolve to the same file once created, accounting for the containing directory's case and Unicode normalization semantics.

nodes.name: pathsAlias
nodes.summary: Exported function that determines whether two paths refer to the same file identity, checking existing-file inode identity first and falling back to future-path alias detection.

nodes.name: resolveOutputPath
nodes.summary: Main exported entry point: chooses the output path from CLI/meta/default sources, enforces meta.output constraints (relative, .html, inside cwd), and rejects any output that aliases an input path or another declared output target.

nodes.name: OutputPathError
nodes.summary: Error subclass carrying a structured Archify diagnostic (code, message, subject, evidence, supportedFixes) describing exactly why an output path was rejected.

nodes.name: copyInstalledSkill

nodes.name: directoryAliasesNames
nodes.summary: Test helper that writes a probe file under an authored name and checks whether a lookup name in the same directory stats to the same inode, verifying filesystem alias behavior.

nodes.name: waitForState
nodes.summary: Test helper that polls the preview server's /state endpoint until a predicate matches or a timeout elapses, failing the test with the last observed state on timeout.

nodes.name: rawRequest
nodes.summary: Test helper that issues a raw HTTP request against the preview server with configurable method, path, and Host header, resolving with status, body, and headers.

nodes.name: fixture

nodes.name: waitForState

nodes.name: scenarios.mjs
